title: Helpdesk Technician - Night Shift Only
description:
Role Summary
As a Helpdesk Technician on the night shift at Ankabut ISP, you will be a crucial part of our customer support team, providing assistance and resolving technical issues for our customers during the night hours. Your dedication and expertise will ensure that our clients receive exceptional helpdesk support, enhancing their experience with our services.

Duties and Responsibilities
Provide efficient and responsive helpdesk support to customers during the night shift.
Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues related to internet connectivity, network configuration, and software problems.
Offer guidance and solutions to customers' inquiries and concerns, ensuring their satisfaction and understanding.
Document and track customer issues, resolutions, and follow-up actions accurately in the helpdesk system.
Collaborate with the day shift team to ensure a seamless transition of support and information.
Keep up to date with the latest technologies, products, and services to provide effective support and assistance.
Contribute to the development and maintenance of a knowledge base for common technical issues and resolutions.
Escalate complex issues to senior technicians or other relevant departments as needed.
Maintain a professional and customer-focused approach in all interactions with clients.

Job Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field is preferred.
Relevant experience in helpdesk support, technical support, or a related role is an advantage.
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently during night hours.
Knowledge of networking, computer hardware, and software.
Excellent communication and customer service skills.
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.
Willingness to work exclusively during night shifts to provide 24/7 customer support.

Submission Guidelines
If you are a dedicated and skilled technician with a background in computer science and a passion for providing exceptional helpdesk support, we encourage you to apply. Please send your resume and a cover letter to hr@ankabut.af with the subject line "Helpdesk Technician (Night Shift) Application - [Your Name]." Be sure to highlight your relevant qualifications and experience.
Ankabut ISP is an equal opportunity employer, and we welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds to join our team.

title: Regional Network Engineer (Mazar)
description:
Role Summary
The Regional Network Engineer handles network-related tasks assigned by the line manager. Under the line manager's direct guidance and supervision, he/she provides daily technical support to maintain the AWCC Corporate Network and ensure 100% availability of the technology environment.

Duties and Responsibilities
Ensure the effective functioning of the WLAN/LAN and the use of documentation tools, focusing on achieving the following results:
Compliance with corporate WLAN/LAN maintenance and technology standards, policies, guidelines, and procedures.
Identify and implement innovative uses of the WLAN and LAN which would enhance the AWCC offices' effectiveness.
Provide effective desktop, WLAN, LAN, and Communication support, focusing on the achievement of the following results:
Set up and maintain the WLAN and LAN Communications in the AWCC offices.
Reconfigure new equipment and systems in WLAN and LAN, and take corrective actions in case of failure.
Troubleshoot and monitor network problems, such as network traffic, usage, and performance.
Implement backup and restoration procedures for all Cisco and Juniper devices that are in the Access Layers of the AWCC network.
Maintain network access policies and control systems to ensure that all AWCC corporate Access Layer equipment is in proper repair and working to maintain satisfactory communications.
Maintain logs of reported problems and corrective measures taken.
Ensure Effective Network Administration, focusing on the achievement of the following results:
Administer the AWCC Corporate network to provide a stable and responsive environment.
Maintain up-to-date parameters of information for the network devices, including network mapping, configuration backup, etc.
Monitor the network stability 24/7 and report the stability to the line manager.
Troubleshoot MW RAD converters and multiplexers to ensure connectivity between AWCC offices, remote sites, and AWCC regional offices.
Perform any other tasks assigned by the line manager.

Job Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Telecommunications, or a relevant field.
Must have 2 to 3 years of relevant work experience (1 year of experience for a master's degree).
Fluent in one of the local languages (Dari, Pashto) and English (written and spoken).
Must have good knowledge of computer programs.
Familiarity with relevant software, tools, and technology specific to the role.
Must have completed the Network+, CCNA, CCNP, MTCNA, and JNCIA certifications and training.
Experience in PC support, remote communications, local & wide area networking.
Knowledge of wireless LAN infrastructure - Wireless APs (802.11x) and Experience managing wireless end-user devices.
Demonstrates a strong work ethic.
Possesses excellent communication skills.
Upholds integrity and honesty.
Capable of performing well under pressure.
Ability to troubleshoot and resolve issues that arise during work.
Willingness to travel to other provinces and work additional hours.
Adheres to company rules and policies.

Submission Guidelines
The interested candidates should fill out and submit the APPLICATION FORM with complete and correct information. To have access to the APPLICATION FORM, please copy and paste the link into your Web Browser.

title: Data Analyst (Working Remotely)
company: Afghan Amputee Bicyclists for Rehabilitation And Recreation (AABRAR)
description:
Job Summary
This position will support analyses of project data from three skills development courses. The courses follow a Knowledge-Attitude-Behavior (KAB) model. Data was generated through pre- and post-course tests and feedback from course participants and Coach-Mentors (project staff). Data was collected by questionnaires, interviews, focus group discussions and direct observations.
Job Description:
Analyze the project data to quantify change in knowledge, attitude and behavior across the three courses.
Support the project team in interpretation of experiences of course participants and Coach-Mentors.
Prepare clear, defensible findings for the project report.
Facilitate discussions within the AABRAR Monitoring-Evaluation-Accountability-Learning team to explore the project dataset.
Guide the MEAL team and project team in the development of data presentations for stakeholders.
Provide feedback to the MEAL team and project team on opportunities to strengthen AABRAR’s approach to data-related Monitoring and Evaluation processes.
Maintain accurate records of considerations and decision on analyses in line with AABRAR's objectives to enhance the skills of the MEAL team.
Any other assignments from the AABRAR Technical Director pertaining to the data analyses.

Job Requirements
• Master-level degree in Statistics, Biostatistics, Epidemiology, Public Health, Social Research Methods, Education Measurement or a related quantitative field; PhD preferred.
• Formal training in quantitative analysis of survey and assessment data, including pre-post comparison and analysis of small, unequal subgroups.
• Formal training or demonstrated competence in qualitative methods, including structured coding and thematic analysis.
• Additional training in behavior-change measurement (such as KAB), psychometrics or program evaluation is an advantage.

Submission Guideline
· Prepare a comprehensive application package: CV
· Email your CV to hr@aabrar.org.af
· Use the proper email subject format: "Application for Data Analyst - Vacancy #[Vacancy Number]."
· Include your contact information in your CV
· Meet the specified application deadline.
· Wait for HR to review your application and contact you if shortlisted.
· Follow provided instructions for the interview process.

title: CPIMS+ Supervisor
category: Case Management, Child Protection, Psychosocial Support, Social Work
description:
Role Summary
The CPIMS Supervisor is responsible for the overall supervision, coordination, and quality assurance of child protection information management and field-level protection activities. The position supervises a team consisting of Social Workers and PSS Counselors and ensures effective implementation of child protection interventions including case management, Child Friendly Spaces (CFS), psychosocial support (PSS), awareness raising sessions, and positive parenting sessions and any other activities.
The CPIMS Supervisor ensures accurate and timely management of child protection data through CPIMS, monitors the quality of case management documentation, provides technical support to field teams, and ensures that services are delivered in accordance with child protection standards, organizational policies, donor requirements, and humanitarian principles.

Duties and Responsibilities
· Supervise, guide, and provide technical support to Social Workers, Para social worker and PSS Counselors.
· Develop and monitor team work plans, daily activities, and field implementation.
· Conduct regular team meetings to review progress, challenges, and achievements.
· Provide coaching and mentoring to improve staff capacity and performance.
· Monitor staff compliance with organizational policies and child safeguarding principles.
· Ensure accurate, complete, and timely entry of child protection case data into CPIMS.
· Monitor the quality of information entered by Social Workers.
· Conduct regular data verification and quality checks between CPIMS and reporting tools.
· Identify data gaps, inconsistencies, and duplication and ensure corrective actions are taken.
· Maintain confidentiality and protection of sensitive child protection information.
· Support preparation of CPIMS-based reports, statistics, and analysis.
· Monitor the full case management cycle.
· Ensure vulnerable children receive appropriate and timely protection services.
· Review case documentation and provide technical feedback to Social Workers.
· Ensure proper referral pathways are followed for specialized services.
· Monitor high-risk cases and ensure appropriate follow-up.
· Supervise implementation of CFS activities and ensure safe and child-friendly environments.
· Monitor attendance, participation, and quality of activities.
· Ensure activities support children’s wellbeing, protection, and development.
· Provide guidance to field teams for improvement of CFS services.
· Monitor quality delivery of individual and group psychosocial support activities.
· Provide technical support to PSS Counselors.
· Ensure identification and referral of children requiring specialized mental health and psychosocial services.
· Monitor PSS documentation and reporting.
· Supervise community awareness sessions related to child protection risks and available services.
· Monitor awareness session and ensure quality implementation.
· Ensure proper documentation of awareness and community engagement activities.
· Review field reports and provide technical feedback.
· Prepare regular CPIMS and child protection activity reports.
· Analyze trends and provide recommendations for program improvement.
· Coordinate with Child Protection Manager, project staff, community structures, and relevant stakeholders.
· Participate in project meetings, assessments, monitoring visits, and coordination forums.
· Perform other duties assigned by the line manager related to child protection activities.

Job Requirements
· Bachelor’s degree in Social Work, Psychology, Sociology, Information Management, Social Sciences, Human Rights, or other related fields. A Master’s degree is an advantage.
· Minimum 3–5 years of relevant experience in child protection, case management, or information management within humanitarian or development programs.
· Proven experience in supervising case workers and managing child protection case management activities.
· Strong knowledge and practical experience in CPIMS+/Primero systems and child protection information management.
· Experience in capacity building, mentoring, and coaching staff.
· Good understanding of child protection principles, case management guidelines, and safeguarding standards.
· Experience in coordination with inter-agency partners, technical teams, and child protection stakeholders.
· Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and database management systems.
· Fluency in English and local languages (Persian and Pashto), both written and spoken.

Submission Guidelines
Interested candidate can submit their resume along with cover letter to below email address.
Please mention the vacancy No and title in subject of the email.
only shortlisted candidate will be called for interview.

hr@hysiafg.org

title: NOC Engineer
application_subject: FW-NOC-001-2026 – NOC Engineer . Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted
description:
Job Summary
The NOC Officer monitors FastWave's network during assigned shifts: core routers, uplinks, servers and network services. The officer detects outages and degradation early, records and classifies incidents, performs first-level troubleshooting, escalates to the right team and follows each incident until service is restored. The position reports to the Team Leader and receives technical guidance from the Network Engineer.

Job Requirements
Good knowledge of TCP/IP, subnetting, routing, NAT, DHCP, DNS and PPPoE.
Solid Layer 2 switching knowledge: VLANs, STP, bridging, MAC tables and interface diagnostics.
Hands-on experience with MikroTik, including PPPoE server user and profile management.
Experience with network monitoring tools such as The Dude or PRTG.
Logical problem-solving and ability to stay calm under pressure.
Clear written reporting: incident logs, daily status and outage reports; MS Excel and Word.
Fluent in Dari or Pashto with working knowledge of the other; English for reading technical documents.
Preferred: MTCNA, CCNA or MTCRE; experience with RADIUS-based billing systems; multi-vendor network experience.

Submission Guideline
Qualified and interested candidates should send their updated CV and a short cover letter to [hr@fastwave.af]. Write the vacancy number and position title in the email subject line: FW-NOC-001-2026 – NOC Engineer . Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

title: Administration, IT & Liaison Officer
description:
Job Summary
The Administration, IT & Liaison Officer will be responsible for ensuring the smooth functioning of ASLO's administrative operations, providing effective day-to-day IT support, and maintaining professional coordination and communication with relevant government authorities, partner organizations, service providers, and other external stakeholders.
The position combines three interrelated support functions: administration, information technology, and institutional liaison. The successful candidate will ensure that office facilities, equipment, information systems, administrative services, and external coordination activities are managed efficiently, professionally, and in accordance with ASLO's policies and procedures.
The incumbent is expected to demonstrate strong organizational, technical, communication, and problem-solving skills while maintaining confidentiality, accountability, and a service-oriented approach.
Key Duties and Responsibilities
A. Administration and Office Management
Ensure the effective day-to-day management and smooth operation of ASLO's office facilities and administrative services.
Manage office supplies, stationery, equipment, furniture, and other administrative resources, ensuring proper stock monitoring and timely replenishment.
Maintain and regularly update the organization's asset register, inventory records, equipment assignment forms, and other administrative databases.
Coordinate office maintenance, cleaning, security, utilities, and other facility-related services.
Support procurement and logistics processes in coordination with the relevant departments, ensuring compliance with organizational procurement procedures.
Maintain an organized filing system for administrative documents, contracts, agreements, correspondence, and office records.
Monitor office-related expenditures and support the preparation of administrative reports and budget utilization updates.
Ensure proper management and maintenance of office equipment and facilities.
Coordinate meetings, workshops, official visits, and other organizational events, including venue arrangements and logistical support.
Provide administrative support to management and other departments as required.
B. Information Technology (IT) Support and Management
Provide first-line technical support to staff regarding computers, laptops, printers, scanners, internet connectivity, email accounts, and other IT equipment.
Install, configure, update, and maintain operating systems, software applications, antivirus programs, and other authorized IT tools.
Monitor and troubleshoot office network infrastructure, internet connectivity, routers, switches, and Wi-Fi systems.
Ensure regular data backup arrangements and support the secure storage and retrieval of organizational information.
Assist in maintaining appropriate cybersecurity practices, including password protection, access control, antivirus updates, and protection against unauthorized access.
Maintain an updated inventory of IT equipment, software licenses, assigned devices, and related technical assets.
Support staff in using Microsoft Office applications, email platforms, online meeting tools, and other organizational software.
Identify IT-related needs and recommend appropriate hardware, software, and technical solutions to management.
Coordinate with external IT service providers for specialized maintenance, repairs, installations, and technical support when necessary.
Ensure that IT equipment is properly maintained, secured, and used in accordance with organizational policies.
Maintain records of IT incidents, troubleshooting activities, equipment repairs, and technical support provided.
Support the implementation of basic IT security and data protection measures in coordination with management.
C. Liaison and External Coordination
Maintain professional communication and coordination with relevant government ministries, departments, directorates, and other authorized institutions.
Facilitate official correspondence, document submission, follow-up, and collection of required approvals, letters, permits, and other administrative documents.
Coordinate with relevant government authorities regarding organizational registration, operational permissions, official notifications, and other institutional requirements, as assigned.
Establish and maintain professional working relationships with NGOs, UN agencies, partner organizations, suppliers, and other relevant stakeholders.
Represent ASLO in routine administrative coordination meetings and official follow-up activities when delegated by management.
Facilitate the preparation and submission of official letters, reports, applications, and other required documents to external institutions.
Maintain an updated record of institutional contacts, correspondence, meeting outcomes, and follow-up actions.
Monitor relevant administrative and regulatory developments that may affect ASLO's operations and promptly inform management.
Ensure that all external communications and representations are conducted professionally and in accordance with ASLO's authorization and communication protocols.
Follow up on pending matters with external institutions and provide timely updates to the relevant supervisor.
D. Reporting, Compliance and Other Responsibilities
Prepare regular administrative, IT, and liaison activity reports for the supervisor.
Ensure that administrative and IT-related activities comply with ASLO's internal policies, procedures, and applicable regulations.
Maintain confidentiality and safeguard organizational information, documents, equipment, and electronic records.
Support internal and external audits by providing relevant administrative, procurement, inventory, and IT documentation.
Identify operational challenges and recommend practical improvements to administrative systems and procedures.
Perform other relevant duties assigned by the supervisor within the scope of the position.

Job Requirements
Education:
Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, Computer Science, Public Administration, Management, or another relevant field from a recognized university.
Candidates with a bachelor's degree in another discipline may also be considered if they possess substantial relevant professional experience and demonstrated technical competencies.
Relevant professional certificates in IT support, networking, system administration, office management, or procurement will be considered an advantage.
Professional Experience:
Minimum of five (5) years of relevant professional experience in administration, office management, IT support, liaison, or a combination of these functions.
At least two (2) years of practical experience in providing IT support, including computer maintenance, software installation, troubleshooting, networking, and internet connectivity.
Demonstrated experience in administrative operations, office management, asset and inventory control, logistics, and procurement coordination.
Proven experience coordinating with government institutions, NGOs, private-sector service providers, or other external stakeholders.
Previous experience working with national or international NGOs, humanitarian organizations, or development agencies will be an advantage.
Technical Skills and Competencies
The successful candidate should demonstrate the following competencies:
IT and Technical Skills: Good practical knowledge of computer hardware, software installation, troubleshooting, networking, internet systems, printers, scanners, and basic cybersecurity.
Administrative Management: Strong understanding of office administration, asset management, inventory control, procurement documentation, logistics, and facilities management.
Liaison and Coordination: Ability to communicate and coordinate professionally with government authorities, institutional stakeholders, and external partners.
Computer Literacy: Excellent working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, particularly Word, Excel, Outlook, and PowerPoint.
Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills, including professional correspondence and report writing.
Planning and Organization: Ability to prioritize multiple assignments, manage deadlines, and maintain accurate records.
Problem-Solving: Ability to identify operational and technical challenges and provide practical solutions.
Confidentiality and Integrity: Demonstrated commitment to professional ethics, accountability, transparency, and confidentiality.
Teamwork: Ability to work collaboratively with different departments and provide responsive support to colleagues.
Flexibility: Ability to work independently, adapt to changing organizational priorities, and perform occasional field or external coordination duties.
Language Requirements
Fluency in Dari and Pashto (written and spoken) is required.
Good working proficiency in English, particularly in written communication and official correspondence, is highly desirable.
Key Performance Expectations
The performance of the incumbent will be assessed based on the following areas:
Timely and effective delivery of administrative and office management services.
Proper maintenance and accurate updating of organizational assets and inventory records.
Timely resolution or appropriate escalation of IT-related problems.
Effective maintenance of IT equipment, systems, and basic data security arrangements.
Timely and professional follow-up with government authorities and external stakeholders.
Accuracy, completeness, and timely submission of administrative and IT reports.
Compliance with organizational policies, procedures, and confidentiality requirements.
Quality of internal customer service and coordination with other departments.

Submission Guideline
Safeguarding, PSEA and Code of Conduct
The selected candidate must comply with ASLO’s Code of Conduct and policies on safeguarding, child safeguarding, prevention of sexual exploitation and abuse, anti-harassment, anti-fraud and anti-corruption, conflict of interest, sanctions, data protection and whistleblowing. Appointment is subject to satisfactory reference checks, identity and qualification verification, and any other lawful screening required by ASLO or its partners. ASLO applies zero tolerance to sexual exploitation, abuse, harassment, fraud, corruption and retaliation.
Application and Selection Process
Qualified candidates should submit the following:
1. An updated curriculum vitae, preferably no longer than four pages.
2. A tailored cover letter explaining suitability for the role and summarizing verifiable fundraising achievements.
3. Contact details for three professional referees, including at least one recent supervisor; referees will be contacted only at the appropriate stage.
4. A non-confidential writing sample or brief description of major proposals/awards personally led, clearly stating the candidate’s role.
Submission Method
Send a single PDF application to: recruitment@aslo.org.af
Email Subject
Application - Administration, IT & Liaison Officer - [Candidate Name]
Closing Date
30-November-26
The selection process may include application screening, a written technical assessment, a proposal or strategy presentation, competency-based interviews, reference checks and verification of qualifications and employment history. Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted. Incomplete, misleading or late applications may not be considered.
Important notice: ASLO does not charge any fee at any stage of recruitment. Candidates should not make any payment or provide money to any person claiming to influence the recruitment process.
Equal Opportunity Statement
ASLO is committed to a fair, transparent and merit-based recruitment process. Qualified women, persons with disabilities and candidates from diverse backgrounds are strongly encouraged to apply. Recruitment decisions are based on the requirements of the role, demonstrated competence, integrity and organizational fit, subject to applicable law and operational requirements.

title: Health Specialist (Health Systems Strengthening) (NO-3), #132838, FT, Kabul, Afghanistan
description:
Role Summary
How can you make a difference?
As a Health Specialist, you will report to the Health Manager (HSS) for guidance and general supervision. You will support the development and preparation of the Basic Package of Health Services (BPHS) and Essential Package of Hospital Services (EPHS), as well as health systems strengthening (HSS) initiatives.
You will be responsible for supporting the management, implementation, monitoring, evaluation and reporting of progress under the BPHS/EPHS programme, including areas such as gender, maternal and neonatal health, and child survival and development, within the country programme.
You will provide technical guidance and management support throughout the programming process to facilitate the administration and achievement of concrete and sustainable results for BPHS/EPHS and HSS, in accordance with programme plans, resource allocations, results-based management (RBM) approaches and methodologies, UNICEF's Strategic Plan and goals, performance standards and accountability framework.

Duties and Responsibilities
Key functions and accountabilities:
Support to programme development and planning
Programme management, monitoring and delivery of results
Technical and operational support to programme implementation
Networking and partnership building
Innovation, knowledge management and capacity building
If you would like to know more about this position, please review the complete Job Description here:
Job Description Health Specialist (HSS) NO3 Kabul VA.pdf

Job Requirements
To qualify as an advocate for every child you will have…
Minimum requirements:
Education : An advanced university degree (Master’s degree or equivalent) in public health, health systems strengthening, health policy and/or management, or another relevant technical field is required.
Work Experience : A minimum of five (5) years of relevant professional experience in health systems strengthening, public health planning and management, or maternal and neonatal health care is required. Experience working in a developing country is required.
Skills : Strong skills in health systems strengthening, results-based management, programme management, analytical and evidence-based decision-making, and partnership management are required.
Language Requirements : Fluency in English is required.
Desirables:
Experience in at least two relevant health-system domains is an asset. These may include health financing and resource allocation, health-service delivery and contracting/oversight of implementing partners, health workforce, essential medicines and health-supply systems, health information systems, monitoring and evaluation, quality of care, or health-sector governance and coordination.
Experience in a UN system agency or organization or an international non-governmental organization (INGO) is an asset.
Experience in large-scale programmes and engagement with provincial and district health structures is desirable.
Experience at country level, particularly in development, fragile settings and humanitarian contexts, is an asset.
Experience working on projects funded by the World Bank (WB) and/or Asian Development Bank (ADB) is an asset.
Knowledge of another official UN language (Arabic, Chinese, French, Russian or Spanish) is an asset.
Fluency is both local languages, Pashto and Dari, is an asset.

Submission Guidelines
Remarks:
As per Article 101, paragraph 3, of the Charter of the United Nations, the paramount consideration in the employment of the staff is the necessity of securing the highest standards of efficiency, competence, and integrity.
UNICEF is committed to fostering an inclusive, representative, and welcoming workforce. For this position, eligible and suitable candidates are encouraged to apply.
Government employees who are considered for employment with UNICEF are normally required to resign from their government positions before taking up an assignment with UNICEF. UNICEF reserves the right to withdraw an offer of appointment, without compensation, if a visa or medical clearance is not obtained, or necessary inoculation requirements are not met, within a reasonable period for any reason.
UNICEF does not charge a processing fee at any stage of its recruitment, selection, and hiring processes (i.e., application stage, interview stage, validation stage, or appointment and training). UNICEF will not ask for applicants' bank account information.
Humanitarian action is a cross-cutting priority within UNICEF's Strategic Plan. UNICEF is committed to stay and deliver in humanitarian contexts. Therefore, all staff, at all levels across all functional areas, can be called upon to be deployed to support humanitarian response, contributing to both strengthening resilience of communities and capacity of national authorities.
Visa residence requirements: i.e. UNICEF shall not facilitate the issuance of a visa and working authorization for candidates under consideration for positions at the national officer and general service category.
All UNICEF positions are advertised, and only shortlisted candidates will be contacted and advance to the next stage of the selection process. An internal candidate performing at the level of the post in the relevant functional area, or an internal/external candidate in the corresponding Talent Group, may be selected, if suitable for the post, without assessment of other candidates.
Additional information about working for UNICEF can be found here .
Interested candidates may submit their application through this link: https://jobs.unicef.org/jobs/health-specialist-health-systems-strengthening-no-3-132838-ft-kabul-afghanistan-open-to-afghan-nationals-only-afghanistan
Applications via JOBS.AF will not be considered.

title: Health Specialist (Health Systems Strengthening) (NO-3), #132838, FT, Kabul, Afghanistan
description:
Job Summary
How can you make a difference?
As a Health Specialist, you will report to the Health Manager (HSS) for guidance and general supervision. You will support the development and preparation of the Basic Package of Health Services (BPHS) and Essential Package of Hospital Services (EPHS), as well as health systems strengthening (HSS) initiatives.
You will be responsible for supporting the management, implementation, monitoring, evaluation and reporting of progress under the BPHS/EPHS programme, including areas such as gender, maternal and neonatal health, and child survival and development, within the country programme.
You will provide technical guidance and management support throughout the programming process to facilitate the administration and achievement of concrete and sustainable results for BPHS/EPHS and HSS, in accordance with programme plans, resource allocations, results-based management (RBM) approaches and methodologies, UNICEF's Strategic Plan and goals, performance standards and accountability framework.
Duties and Responsibilities
Key functions and accountabilities:
Support to programme development and planning
Programme management, monitoring and delivery of results
Technical and operational support to programme implementation
Networking and partnership building
Innovation, knowledge management and capacity building
If you would like to know more about this position, please review the complete Job Description here:
Job Description Health Specialist (HSS) NO3 Kabul VA.pdf

Job Requirements
To qualify as an advocate for every child you will have…
Minimum requirements:
Education : An advanced university degree (Master’s degree or equivalent) in public health, health systems strengthening, health policy and/or management, or another relevant technical field is required.
Work Experience : A minimum of five (5) years of relevant professional experience in health systems strengthening, public health planning and management, or maternal and neonatal health care is required. Experience working in a developing country is required.
Skills : Strong skills in health systems strengthening, results-based management, programme management, analytical and evidence-based decision-making, and partnership management are required.
Language Requirements : Fluency in English is required.
Desirables:
Experience in at least two relevant health-system domains is an asset. These may include health financing and resource allocation, health-service delivery and contracting/oversight of implementing partners, health workforce, essential medicines and health-supply systems, health information systems, monitoring and evaluation, quality of care, or health-sector governance and coordination.
Experience in a UN system agency or organization or an international non-governmental organization (INGO) is an asset.
Experience in large-scale programmes and engagement with provincial and district health structures is desirable.
Experience at country level, particularly in development, fragile settings and humanitarian contexts, is an asset.
Experience working on projects funded by the World Bank (WB) and/or Asian Development Bank (ADB) is an asset.
Knowledge of another official UN language (Arabic, Chinese, French, Russian or Spanish) is an asset.
Fluency is both local languages, Pashto and Dari, is an asset.

title: MEAL Officer
description:
Job Summary
Job Summary:
The MEAL Officer is responsible for supporting the design, implementation, and management of Monitoring, Evaluation, Accountability, and Learning systems to ensure quality programming, evidence-based decision-making, donor compliance, and continuous organizational learning. The position will ensure timely collection, analysis, reporting, and utilization of project data to improve program effectiveness and accountability to beneficiaries and stakeholders.
Duties and Responsibilities:
Develop and maintain project monitoring plans, indicator tracking tables, and data collection tools.
Monitor project implementation against approved work plans, log frames, and targets.
Conduct regular field visits to verify activities and assess progress.
Track project outputs, outcomes, and performance indicators.
Ensure timely and accurate collection of quantitative and qualitative data.
Support project teams in measuring achievements against established indicators.
Support the design and implementation of baseline, midline, end-line, and impact assessments.
Participate in needs assessments, surveys, and evaluations.
Coordinate data collection activities for internal and external evaluations.
Analyse evaluation findings and provide recommendations for program improvement.
Assist in preparing evaluation reports and disseminating results to stakeholders.
Develop and update project Performance Measurement Frameworks (PMFs).
Define project indicators, means of verification, targets, and reporting frequencies.
Track donor-specific and organizational indicators.
Verify indicator achievements through supporting documentation and evidence.
Maintain indicator databases and dashboards to monitor progress.
Establish and maintain data management systems and databases.
Verify data quality, accuracy, completeness, consistency, and reliability.
Conduct routine data cleaning and validation exercises.
Analyze project data and generate statistical summaries, charts, and dashboards.
Ensure proper data storage, confidentiality, and protection standards are maintained.
Prepare monthly, quarterly, annual, and donor-required MEAL reports.
Provide accurate data and analysis for programmatic and donor reporting.
Develop data visualizations and performance summaries for management decision-making.
Compile beneficiary statistics, achievements, lessons learned, and challenges.
Support preparation of presentations and project performance updates.
Establish and manage beneficiary feedback and complaint response mechanisms.
Ensure communities are aware of available accountability channels.
Record, track, and follow up on complaints, feedback, and suggestions.
Ensure confidential and timely handling of sensitive complaints.
Generate accountability reports and recommend corrective actions where necessary.
Document lessons learned, best practices, case studies, and success stories.
Facilitate reflection meetings, review workshops, and learning sessions.
Promote the use of MEAL findings to improve program quality and effectiveness.
Support the development of organizational knowledge products.
Share learning and evidence with project teams and management.
Train project staff and partners on MEAL tools, systems, and methodologies.
Build staff capacity in data collection, data quality, reporting, and indicator tracking.
Conduct routine Data Quality Assessments (DQAs).
Ensure compliance with organizational, donor, and sector-specific MEAL standards.
Provide technical support to project teams on monitoring and evaluation practices.
Support internal and external audits related to project performance and data quality.
Any other tasks assigned by the Supervisor.

Job Requirements
Education
Bachelor's Degree in Statistics, Economics, Development Studies, Public Administration, Monitoring & Evaluation, or a related field.
A Master's Degree will be considered an advantage.
Experience
Minimum 4 years of relevant professional experience in MEAL, Monitoring & Evaluation (M&E), data management, research, or project performance monitoring within NGOs, INGOs and UN agencies.
Demonstrated experience in designing and managing monitoring systems, indicator tracking, evaluations, and data analysis.
Experience in donor-funded projects and reporting requirements.
Technical Skills
Strong knowledge of MEAL frameworks, logical frameworks (Log frames), and Results-Based Management (RBM).
Experience with data collection platforms such as Kobo Toolbox, ODK, MODA, Survey CTO, or similar tools.
Strong quantitative and qualitative data analysis skills.
Knowledge of Power BI, SPSS, STATA, or other analytical software is an advantage.
Organizational Responsibilities:
Notice to Applicants: Please be aware that as part of our commitment to ensuring the highest standards of professional conduct, all candidates applying for a position with our organization will be subject to comprehensive background and reference checks. This is to verify the accuracy of the information provided and assess suitability for the role. In addition, we place a strong emphasis on ethical behavior and integrity in our work environment. As such, adherence to our code of conduct forms an integral part of our annual performance appraisal process. We encourage all prospective applicants to bear this in mind when applying.
Policy Adherence
Adhere to the Code of Conduct, all applicable policies of the ASIO, maintain humanitarian principles and respect international humanitarian law.
Fraud prevention:
Committed to fraud prevention, detection, reporting and fraud risk reduction as per ASIO policies and procedures, donor regulations and local laws.
Prevention of Sexual Exploitation and Abuse (PSEA):
The Afghanistan Social Improvement Organization (ASIO) strictly prohibits any form of Sexual Exploitation and Abuse by its staff towards the individuals they serve. Such actions are in direct violation of the universally recognized norms, values, principles, and standards that form the foundation of our organization. The responsibility of safeguarding against Sexual Exploitation and Abuse (PSEA) lies with everyone, and all potential candidates must adhere to ASIO’s PSEA Policy without exception. Consequently, candidates under consideration will be subjected to thorough reference and background checks concerning any past incidents of sexual exploitation and abuse. They may also be asked to furnish additional information as part of the selection process.
Compliance & Ethics:
Promotes and encourages a culture of compliance and ethics throughout and within Afghanistan Social Improvement Organization “ASIO”. As applicable to the position, maintains a clear understanding of within Afghanistan Social Improvement Organization “ASIO” and donor compliance and ethics standards and adheres to those standards. Conducts tasks with the highest level of integrity.
Safeguarding:
It is all staff’s shared responsibility and obligation to safeguard and protect populations with whom we work, including adults who may be particularly vulnerable and children. We must ensure that our staff and partners do not engage in any conduct that could harm or exploit these individuals. This includes sexual exploitation and abuse, neglect or abuse of children and adults at risk, and any form of human trafficking.

Submission Guideline
Interested applicants are invited to submit their Curriculum Vitae (CV) through the following link: https://hrms.asio.org.af/jobs/11
Please ensure that the position title and vacancy number are included in the subject line (e.g., MEAL Officer- ASIO26/0086 ), applications that do not follow this format will not be considered.
Only short-listed candidates will be contacted for a written test and/or interview. If you do not hear from us within two to three weeks after the closing date, please assume that your application was not successful.
Note: Please do not attach your educational certificates, diplomas, or experience documents at the application stage.
Email / Application Form: https://hrms.asio.org.af/jobs/11

title: Network Officer
description:
Role Summary
Insta Telecom is seeking a skilled and motivated Network Officer to join its Technical and Network Operations team in Kabul.
The Network Officer will be responsible for planning, deploying, configuring, monitoring, maintaining, and troubleshooting wireless Point-to-Point (PTP), Point-to-Multipoint (PTMP), and Fiber-to-the-Home (FTTH) network infrastructure.
The successful candidate will conduct technical site surveys, manage customer installations and service activations, maintain network reliability, troubleshoot connectivity issues, and coordinate with the NOC, Fiber, FTTH, and Engineering teams to ensure efficient network operations and high-quality internet services.
The position also involves supervising field technicians, preparing technical reports, supporting network expansion projects, and ensuring compliance with company technical standards and Service Level Agreements (SLAs).

Duties and Responsibilities
Wireless Network Deployment (PTP/PTMP)
· Conduct technical site surveys for PTP and PTMP wireless network installations and prepare feasibility assessment reports.
· Plan, install, configure, align, test, and commission wireless links according to company standards.
· Perform wireless link performance testing, signal optimization, and connectivity verification.
· Manage customer installation activities from initial survey to final service activation.
· Support network expansion, customer migrations, and equipment upgrades.
Network Monitoring & Troubleshooting
· Monitor network performance, connectivity, signal quality, bandwidth utilization, and service stability.
· Diagnose and resolve wireless network faults, connectivity interruptions, and service degradation.
· Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on wireless radios, network equipment, and customer connections.
· Configure, troubleshoot, and maintain wireless devices and associated networking equipment.
· Ensure network availability, service reliability, and compliance with agreed SLAs.
FTTH & GPON Network Support
· Troubleshoot FTTH network connectivity and customer service issues.
· Diagnose and resolve GPON, OLT, ONT, and fiber-related faults.
· Coordinate with the Fiber and FTTH teams for service restoration and new customer activations.
· Support the installation, testing, and activation of FTTH customer connections.
Documentation & Reporting
· Prepare and maintain site survey reports, installation records, network diagrams, and maintenance documentation.
· Maintain accurate records of network configurations, customer installations, and technical changes.
· Prepare technical incident reports and provide regular updates on assigned activities.
Team Coordination & Supervision
· Coordinate with NOC, Fiber, FTTH, and Engineering teams to resolve technical issues and complete network deployments.
· Supervise and provide technical guidance to field technicians and junior network engineers.
· Support technical training and knowledge sharing among team members.
· Follow company policies, safety procedures, and technical standards.
· Perform other network-related duties assigned by the CTO or management.

Job Requirements
Education
Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Telecommunications, Network Engineering, or a related field.
Relevant technical diplomas with strong practical experience may also be considered.
Professional Experience
Minimum 2–3 years of practical experience in ISP network operations, wireless network deployment, or telecommunications.
Hands-on experience installing, configuring, and troubleshooting PTP and PTMP wireless networks.
Experience in customer premises equipment (CPE) installation and internet service activation.
Experience with FTTH/GPON networks is highly desirable.
Technical Skills
Strong understanding of TCP/IP networking, IP addressing, subnetting, VLANs, routing, and switching.
Practical experience with wireless networking technologies, including PTP and PTMP systems.
Familiarity with equipment from vendors such as Ubiquiti, MikroTik, and Cambium Networks.
Ability to perform wireless site surveys, antenna alignment, signal analysis, and link optimization.
Understanding of wireless frequency planning, interference, signal strength, and link capacity.
Knowledge of PPPoE, DHCP, DNS, NAT, and basic network troubleshooting.
Familiarity with GPON technologies, OLTs, ONTs, and FTTH infrastructure.
Ability to troubleshoot fiber connectivity and optical signal issues.
Knowledge of network monitoring tools and troubleshooting utilities.
Ability to prepare technical documentation and network diagrams.
Certifications (Preferred)
CCNA (Cisco Certified Network Associate).
MikroTik MTCNA or equivalent.
Ubiquiti or Cambium wireless networking certifications.
Other relevant networking certifications are an advantage.

Submission Guidelines
Please submit your CV and a cover letter describing why you are a perfect candidate for this position to jobs@instatelecom.com , and CC noc@instatelecom.com. The vacancy number must be included in the email subject line. NO01102026

title: IT Officer – MIS System Support
category: Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology
description:
Role Summary
The IT Officer – MIS System Support will be responsible for the day-to-day administration, maintenance, security, and operational support of the Aurum MFI MIS system. The successful candidate will serve as the dedicated technical focal point for the system, ensuring its availability, data integrity, proper user access management, timely backups, and effective coordination with relevant departments, software developers, and external technical support providers.

Duties and Responsibilities
Key Responsibilities
1. MIS System Administration
Manage and monitor the day-to-day operation of the Aurum MFI MIS system.
Create, configure, update, suspend, and deactivate user accounts based on authorized requests.
Assign and manage user roles and access permissions in accordance with approved policies.
Maintain system configurations, operational settings, and user access records.
Monitor system performance and report technical issues, errors, or operational disruptions.
2. Data Backup and Recovery
Perform and monitor regular backups of the MIS database and related system data.
Verify backup completion and periodically test data restoration procedures.
Maintain backup logs and ensure backups are stored securely in accordance with the approved backup policy.
Coordinate with the relevant technical team to resolve backup failures and support data recovery when required.
Help ensure data integrity, availability, and business continuity.
3. Technical Support and Troubleshooting
Provide first-level technical support to MIS users and resolve routine system-related issues.
Investigate system errors, access problems, data discrepancies, and performance issues.
Document incidents, follow up on unresolved issues, and escalate complex technical problems to the relevant developers or service providers.
Coordinate system troubleshooting, bug fixes, upgrades, patches, and technical improvements.
Support system testing and verification before changes are implemented in the production environment.
4. System Maintenance and Security
Coordinate routine system maintenance and monitor system availability.
Ensure that user access is properly authorized and reviewed periodically.
Follow approved information security, data protection, and access control procedures.
Maintain technical documentation, system configuration records, backup logs, and incident reports.
Identify potential operational and security risks and report them to the relevant team.
5. Technical and Departmental Coordination
Act as the primary IT focal point for MIS-related matters.
Coordinate with the Microfinance Operations team, Finance, relevant business units, software developers, and external technical support providers.
Follow up on reported issues, requested changes, system enhancements, and pending technical tasks.
Assist in gathering business requirements and communicating them to the technical team.
6. Reporting and User Support
Prepare periodic reports on system availability, incidents, backup status, user administration, and maintenance activities.
Maintain an updated record of users, permissions, technical issues, and system changes.
Guide and assist staff in using the MIS system correctly and securely.
Provide basic user training and prepare user guides or operational instructions when necessary.
Perform other relevant IT and MIS support duties assigned by the IT Manager.

Job Requirements
Qualifications and Requirements
Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.
Minimum of 2 years of relevant experience in IT support, MIS support or a similar position.
Experience supporting a Management Information System (MIS), preferably in microfinance, banking, financial services, or another regulated organization.
Understanding of user administration, role-based access control, system security, and data protection.

Strong communication, coordination, problem-solving, and organizational skills.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively with different hospital departments.

HMIS user support and staff training.
Data quality monitoring and reporting.
Information security and confidentiality.
Communication, coordination, and teamwork.

title: Cloud Support Engineer
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1100+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We are hiring a Cloud Support Engineer to build a career with Canonical and support the technical needs of customers leveraging Ubuntu and open source products. If you have an affinity for open source development and a passion for technology, then you will enjoy working with some of the best people in the industry at Canonical .
While our engineers regularly solve deeply interesting, complex technical problems - from triaging cloud environments to root-cause analysis on unseen Linux kernel crashes - this is fundamentally a role rooted in human connection. You will act as a trusted peer and technical guide to external engineering teams, translating intricate open-source challenges into clear, empathetic solutions. We are rapidly expanding and looking for brilliant problem solvers who are just as passionate about building strong, collaborative relationships with customers as they are about the next generation of Canonical solutions.
Location: This is a globally remote role.
The role entails
Empathetic Engagement: Partner directly with customers across remote sessions, ticketing,, and live conversations to deeply understand and resolve their technical roadblocks.
Collaborative Problem Solving: Work hand-in-hand with internal engineering teams and regional peer groups to bridge the gap between complex code fixes and real-world customer satisfaction.
True Ownership: Manage your support cases with a strong sense of personal integrity, ensuring commitments are honored and customer expectations are communicated transparently and predictably.
Ubuntu Lifecycle Guidance: Develop a rich understanding of the Ubuntu development process, empowering you to give customers clear, human context regarding timelines for engineering fixes.
Knowledge Advocacy: Author and maintain accessible knowledge base articles, ensuring lessons learned are shared openly to elevate the entire open-source community.
Operational Reliability: Participate in a regular weekend working rotation to maintain seamless, high-touch continuity of care for our global partners.
What are we looking for in you
Communication Excellence: Exceptional written and spoken English, with a natural ability to convey technical complexity clearly, warmly, and compellingly.
The Soft-Skill Edge: A genuine passion for helping people, paired with the emotional intelligence to navigate high-stakes technical situations with composure and empathy.
Academic Dedication: Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university.
Educational Background: An undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path.
Driven Mindset: A proven track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to deliver meaningful, outstanding results for teams or customers.
Linux & Cloud Familiarity: Practical, hands-on experience supporting Linux systems, with an exposure to three or more of the following:
Virtualization & Cloud: Using KVM or OpenStack.
Containers: primarily Docker, LXD/LXC, or Kubernetes.
Storage Ecosystems: Block, object, and network storage technologies.
System Networking: Navigating bonding, firewalls, bridging, switching, or MTU tuning.

title: Advisor, Financial Systems & Digital Infrastructure (Retainer)
description:
About UNOPS
Background Information - UNOPS
UNOPS – an operational arm of the United Nations – supports the achievement of the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) by successfully implementing its partners’ peacebuilding, humanitarian, and development projects around the world. Our mission is to help people build better lives and countries achieve peace and sustainable development.
UNOPS areas of expertise cover infrastructure, procurement, project management, financial management, and human resources.
Working with us
We are proud of our people. With a wealth of knowledge and skills in various disciplines – engineering, finance, human resources, ICT, leadership, project management, procurement, and more – they help tackle some of the biggest challenges of our time. Their work around the world supports progress toward the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).
At UNOPS, we offer a range of short- and long-term opportunities in various environments and duty stations – from Denmark and Kenya to Mexico, Switzerland, Myanmar, Senegal, Uganda, and many more.
Diversity
With over 5,000 UNOPS personnel and approximately 7,400 personnel recruited on behalf of our partners, spread across 80 countries, our workforce represents a range of nationalities and cultures. We promote a balanced and diverse labor force — a strength that helps us better understand and address our partners’ needs. We continually strive to maintain our gender-balanced workplace. We encourage qualified underrepresented groups as per UNOPS Gender, Diversity, and Inclusion Strategy to apply for our vacancies.

Job Descriptions
Afghanistan
With more than 20 years of experience in the country, UNOPS Afghanistan focuses on providing maximum support to the people of Afghanistan through the delivery of projects and services that improve the lives of people in need. The UNOPS Afghanistan Country Office (AFCO) serves as an organizational mechanism to deliver a range of projects for which UNOPS has been designated as the implementation agency. At present, UNOPS AFCO activities cover a range of sectors including humanitarian, basic human needs, cash for work, infrastructure, development, procurement and HR services.
The functional objective of UNOPS AFCO is to contribute to improving the lives of girls, boys, men and women living in Afghanistan. The aim of UNOPS AFCO is to provide efficient and cost-effective implementation services on behalf of all our partners to support the humanitarian response and development of the country. UNOPS AFCO’s mission is to exceed the expectations of all stakeholders in the delivery of AFCO services, at all times, in all places, in all circumstances, in order to improve the lives of Afghans in need.

Job Requirements
Job Specific Context
UNOPS is the Principal Implementing Agency (PIA) for the Private Sector Resilience Project (PSRP), financed by the World Bank (IDA and ARTF), a project designed to support access to finance and capabilities of MSMEs in selected value chains.
This home-based retainer role is open to both National and International Applicants.
Role Purpose
The Advisor, Financial Systems & Digital Infrastructure will serve on an on-call, milestone-driven retainer basis. The Advisor provides senior technical leadership and policy guidance to the project team and implementing partners. The primary objective is to advise on activities supporting the modernization and resilience of the financial ecosystem in Afghanistan, and advise on knowledge activities, specifically related to financial sector development, credit information sharing systems, digital finance expansion, and shared agent networks. To this end, the retainer will engage with the project team, specialized service providers, project implementing partners, and other stakeholders as required.
Functions / Key Results Expected
1 . Technical Advisory
Serve as the principal technical expert on digital financial infrastructure, retail payment networks, and retail financial ecosystem modernization for the PSRP project.
Provide expert advice and guidance to the Senior Programme Manager (SPM) and project team on relevant areas of the project.
Contribute to the planning of knowledge products and technical diagnostics focused on structural solutions for the Afghanistan’s financial ecosystem, including digital payment systems and agent banking.
Provide strategic technical advice on the design and implementation of Credit Information Sharing Systems to enhance MSME access to formal finance.
Advise on the operationalization and scaling of Shared Agent Networks (SAN), focusing on low-cost delivery models that extend financial access to women-led MSMEs and rural populations.
Stay abreast of global and national regulatory shifts and technical developments in digital asset routing, mobile wallet licensing, and retail payment interoperability frameworks.
Analyze and map the evolving regulatory environment, assessing specific impacts on retail payment interoperability, digital micro-credit origination, and the liquidity requirements for financial sector actors.
2. Stakeholder Engagement and Coordination
Liaise and advise PSRP’s implementing partners on technical matters related to financial sector development.
Under the guidance of the SPM, liaise closely with technical stakeholders in the World Bank and IFC (particularly the Task Team Leads or their delegated technical representatives) on technical matters.
Ensure the PSRP is adequately represented and contributes to wider discussions and working groups on financial sector development; engage in technical meetings and workshops with stakeholders and the donor.
Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders to ensure effective collaboration and project success.
Work with financial service providers to identify obstacles to expanding foreign correspondent relationships and areas to support risk management processes.
Coordinate with other project implementing agencies working on microfinance and credit guarantees to ensure complementarity and cross-component learning of activities.
3. Technical Review
Review and provide technical input on terms of reference (ToRs), tender documents, and proposals for the procurement of specialized technical services.
Review and provide technical input on terms of reference, evaluations and other technical documents related to the contract management of PSRP grantees.
Review and provide technical inputs on deliverables from suppliers of specialised technical services contracted under the project, including but not limited to research and analysis work on credit information sharing systems and digital finance expansion.
Oversee, review, and guide the work of suppliers providing specialized technical assistance to financial service providers to improve financial integrity processes and digital service delivery.
4. Knowledge Sharing and Capacity Building
Contribute to knowledge sharing and capacity building initiatives within UNOPS and with project partners.
Develop and deliver training programs and workshops on private sector development topics.
Document and disseminate lessons learned and best practices from the project, facilitate knowledge exchange and learning events among project stakeholders.
Conduct field visits to project and partner sites to assess the effectiveness of interventions and provide on-site technical assistance.
Support the development of monitoring and evaluation frameworks to track project outcomes and impact.
Contribute to the preparation of project reports, briefs, and presentations for internal and external audiences.
Support the identification and assessment of potential private sector partners for project implementation.
Provide technical input into the design of new private sector development projects and initiatives.
Ensure gender and social inclusion considerations, and the adoption of sustainable and environmentally responsible practices, are integrated into all aspects of project design and implementation.
Skills
Capacity Building, Financial Advisory, Financial Regulations, Market Analysis, Policy Analysis, Public-private Partnerships, Technical Analysis
Competencies
Develops and implements sustainable business strategies, thinks long term and externally in order to positively shape the organisation. Anticipates and perceives the impact and implications of future decisions and activities on other parts of the organisation.
Treats all individuals with respect; responds sensitively to differences and encourages others to do the same. Upholds organisational and ethical norms. Maintains high standards of trustworthiness. Role model for diversity and inclusion.
Acts as a positive role model contributing to the team spirit. Collaborates and supports the development of others. For people managers only: Acts as positive leadership role model, motivates, directs and inspires others to succeed, utilizing appropriate leadership styles.
Demonstrates understanding of the impact of own role on all partners and always puts the end beneficiary first. Builds and maintains strong external relationships and is a competent partner for others (if relevant to the role).
Efficiently establishes an appropriate course of action for self and/or others to accomplish a goal. Actions lead to total task accomplishment through concern for quality in all areas. Sees opportunities and takes the initiative to act on them. Understands that responsible use of resources maximizes our impact on our beneficiaries.
Open to change and flexible in a fast paced environment. Effectively adapts own approach to suit changing circumstances or requirements. Reflects on experiences and modifies own behavior. Performance is consistent, even under pressure. Always pursues continuous improvements.
Evaluates data and courses of action to reach logical, pragmatic decisions. Takes an unbiased, rational approach with calculated risks. Applies innovation and creativity to problem-solving.
Expresses ideas or facts in a clear, concise and open manner. Communication indicates a consideration for the feelings and needs of others. Actively listens and proactively shares knowledge. Handles conflict effectively, by overcoming differences of opinion and finding common ground.

Master's degree in Finance, Financial Technology (FinTech), Banking, Economics, Business Administration, or related field with a minimum of 7 years of relevant experience; OR

Experience in stakeholder engagement and partnership building with representatives from the private sector, government, and donor communities is required.
Experience in conducting high-quality market research and policy analysis related to financial sector development, including the preparation of comprehensive reports and policy recommendations is required.

Technical experience in designing or implementing digital financial systems, credit registries, or interoperable payment architectures.
