title: جین سکونسنگ دیتا انالیست (Gene Sequencing Data Analyst)
description:
Role Summary
هدف وظیفه: تبدیل ارقام تولید شده خام از توالی جین ها (Next Generation Sequencing – NGS) مانند (پنل سرطانی، اگزوم، جینوم) در
لابراتور مرکزی (ریفرنس) به معلومات قابل تطبیق در ساحات کلینیکی جهت استفاده شفاخانه ها و مراکز صحی بخاطر حمایت از پروسه تشخیص و
انتخاب شیوه های مناسب تداوی نزد مریضان و تصمیم گیری مبتنی برشواهد، تضمین کیفیت و اعتبار ارقام، تثبیت وریانت های جنتیکی، تفسیر درست
وریانت ها، ارائه راپور ها و گزارشات با کیفیت بالا و حفظ مؤثریت لابراتوار ریفرنس مطابق به اصول و مقررات وزارت.

Duties and Responsibilities
وظایف و مسئولیت ها:
وظایف اساسی:
1. کنترول کیفیت (Quality Control) ارقام خام بدست آمده از توالی یابی جنیتیک Next Generation Sequencing(NGS) با استفاده از میتود (FastQ files).
2. ارزیابی شاخص های عمق پوشش (Coverage)، کیفیت پایه /اساس (Base Quality)، میزان آلودگی و یکنواختی توالی‌یابی، شناسایی و حذف ارقام بی اعبتار.
3. طی یک سلسله مراحل بیوانفورماتیک (Alignment به ژنوم مرجع، Variant Calling) پی در پی در کمپیوتر که ارقام خام تولید شده از توالی یابی جین ها (NGS) را به معلومات تبدیل مینماید.
4. شناسایی واریانت‌ها، (Variant Calling / Detection) مانند Single Nucleotide Variant (SNV), Interstation /Deletion(Indel)
CNV (Copy Number Variation), Fusion وغیره.
5. تحلیل و تشریح تغیرات ایجاد در واریانت‌ها با استفاده ازذخایر ارقام (دیتابیس) های مانند (ClinVar، gnomAD، COSMIC، HGMD و ...)
6. فیلتر نمودن واولویت‌بندی واریانت‌های کلینیکی مرتبط و طبقه‌ بندی واریانت‌ها به اساس رهنمود های ACMG/AMP (Pathogenic، Likely Pathogenic، VUS، Benign و ...)
7. بررسی ارتباط واریانت با مرض یا پاسخ به تداوی (به ‌ویژه درسرطان وبیماری‌های ژنتیکی).
8. شریک ساختن نتایج با پاتولوژیست و سایر متخصصین و مسؤلین ذیربط غرض تأیید نهایی (Sign-out).
9. رعایت زمان پاسخ‌دهی (Turnaround Time)
10. سهم گیری فعال در اعتبارسنجی (Validation) معاینات انجام شده جدید در بخش NGS.
11. ذخیره ونگهداری مصؤن ارقام ومعلومات تهیه شده
12. همکاری نزدیک با تکنشین‌های مربوط به مالیکولر بیولوژی ، مالیکولر بیولوژی بیولوژیست‌ها و پاتولوژیست‌ها
13. مشارکت در کنترل کیفیت لابراتوار مربوط (مطابق ISO 15189)
14. ارائه مشوره های تخصصی و پشتیبانی از موارد پیچیده وراجع شده غرض معاینه ، تحلیل وتفسیر به لابراتوار به هدایت مقامات ذیربط.
15. مستند سازی دقیق نتایج، نگهداری سوابق و تهیه گزارش‌های علمی، نشر و پخش نتایج دریافت ها در قالب مقالات یا گزارش‌های فنی به مراجع ذیربط.
16. حفظ و نگهداشت مصؤن، کالیبریشن و حصول اطمینان از فعال بودن درست و سایل و تجهیزات مورد استفاده در لابراتوار مربوط.
17. آموزش و رهنمایی کارکنان لابراتوار مربوط، ترینی ها، ستاژران، کارکنان لابراتوار های ساحوی، کارکنان جدید، دربخش استفاده از تکنیک‌های مالیکولی و میتود های جدید، سهم گیری در تحقیقات علمی، سمینارها و ورکشاپ های آموزشی .
18. انکشاف متداوم دانش مسلکی و قابلیت های وظیفوی خودی.
19. رعایت اصول و معیارات اخلاق طبابت و مسلک گرایی طبی و ترویج آن بین کارکنان تحت اثر و سایر همکاران.
وظایف مدیریتی :
1. تهیه و ترتیب پلان کاری ماهوار، ربعوار و سالانه در مطابقت با پلان عمومی اداره مربوط جهت بدست آوردن اهداف تعیین شده.
2. ارایه گزارش ماهوار، ربعوار و سالانه و عندالضرورت از فعالیت ها و دست آورد های بخش مربوطه به آمر بخش مربوطه.
3. اجرای سایر وظایف مرتبط به وظیفه که مطابق قوانین، مقررات، پالسی ها از طرف آمر مربوطه به وی سپرده میشود.
وظایف هماهنگی :
1. تامین ارتباط وهماهنگی با بخش های ذیربط.

Job Requirements
شرایط استخدام:
· داشتن تابعیت افغانستان .
سویه تحصیلی : داشتن سند تحصیلی حد اقل لسانس در رشته علوم بیومیدیکل/ لابراتوار کلنیکی یا تکنالوژی طبی با تائید شده وزارت تحصیلات عالی و داشتن سند فالوشیپ 2 ساله جین سکونسنگ دیتا انالیست تحصیلات بالا تر در بخش علوم بیومیدیکل و انفورماتیک ارجهیت دارد .
تجربه کاری : داشتن تجربه کاری مرتبط به وظیفه مطابق به معیارات قید شده در رهنمود NTA.
مهارت های لازم:
· دانش قوی در علم جنتیک انسانی، مالیکیولر بیولوژی
· تسلط به وسایل بیوانفورماتیک مورد استفاده در امور روزمره (GATK، bwa، Sam tools، ANNOVAR و ...) استفاده از برنامه های کنترول کیفیت (FastQC, MultiQC) در بخش مربوط و داشتن قابلیت استفاده از برنامه ها در (Python، R، Bash).
· تسلط به یکی از زبان ‌های رسمی افغانستان (پشتو یا دری)، تحریر و تکلم روان به یکی از لسان های بین المللی.
· داشتن مهارت ‌های مرتبط به انجام بهتر وظایف در برنامه های کمپیوتر.

Submission Guidelines
رهنمود اعلان :
کاندیدان محترم می توانند سی وی خویش را مطابق اعلان به ایمیل آدرس moph.gdsa@gmail.com ارسال نمایید و یا هارد کاپی آن را به وزارت صحت عامه ریاست عمومی امور کارکنان مدیریت عمومی اعلانات و کاریابی تسلیم نمایید
نوت : مشخص کردن عنوان بست مورد نظر در عنوان ایمیل آدرس ضروری می باشد .
در صورت ضرورت به شماره تلفون ۰۲۰۲۳۱۲۴۲۲ به تماس شوید

title: MEAL Officer
description:
Job Summary
Scope of Work:
The MEAL Officer is responsible for developing, implementing, and strengthening monitoring, evaluation, accountability, and learning systems for MdM-F projects and programmes. The position ensures that reliable and timely data are collected, verified, analysed, and used to assess programme performance, measure results, identify gaps, strengthen accountability to affected populations, and inform evidence-based operational and strategic decision-making.
He/She report s to the Project Manager.
1. Monitoring, Evaluation and Data Collection
· Design, develop, adapt, and implement M&E frameworks, plans, indicators, tools, and data collection systems to monitor project outputs, outcomes, quality, and impact.
· Conduct regular field monitoring visits to supported health facilities (HFs), outreach activities, and other programme locations to verify service delivery, data quality, compliance with agreed standards, and progress against workplans and targets.
· Carry out routine monitoring of programme activities, including relevant logistical components linked to programme interventions, using MdM monitoring tools and approved formats.
· Prepare monitoring reports identifying achievements, gaps, challenges, and recommendations; conduct debriefing sessions with relevant programme staff and follow up on agreed action plans.
· Collect and document beneficiaries’ feedback on access to and quality of healthcare services through exit interviews, satisfaction surveys, focus group discussions, individual interviews, and other appropriate methods.
· Ensure that data are collected accurately, consistently, and on time, and conduct regular data quality checks, verification, cleaning, and validation with relevant staff.
· Support the planning and implementation of needs assessments, baseline studies, routine monitoring exercises, mid-term and end-line evaluations, and impact assessments as required.
· Develop, review, and harmonize data collection and monitoring tools, including needs assessment tools, on-site monitoring checklists, survey tools, prescription audit tools, and other tools required for programme monitoring and proposal development.
· Work closely with the relevant technical teams to maintain an activity calendar for M&E tasks across health facilities and outreach activities, in coordination with the project manager and MEAL advisor.
· Establish and maintain an organized and harmonized filing and archiving system for M&E documents, tools, datasets, reports, and evidence across MdM projects in the targeted provinces and areas.
2. Health Information Systems and Prescription Audits
· Support the collection, review, verification, and analysis of routine health service data and ensure consistency between facility registers, reporting tools, databases, and submitted reports.
· Use and support the use of DHIS2 for routine health information management, including data entry or review, data validation, analysis, and reporting, as applicable to the project and MdM systems.
· Conduct regular monitoring visits to health facilities to review the quality and completeness of medical records, registers, reporting practices, and health information management procedures.
· Coordinate with medical and pharmacy teams to ensure that monthly prescription audits are conducted in each supported health facility in accordance with MdM tools and guidance.
· Participate in prescription audit visits, review prescription practices and audit findings with relevant medical and pharmacy staff, document gaps, and follow up on corrective actions.
· Compile and analyse prescription audit results, identify trends and areas requiring improvement, and share regular reports and recommendations with the Medical Coordinator, Pharmacy team, and relevant Project Managers.
3. Reporting, Data Analysis and Information Management
· Analyse quantitative and qualitative data to measure progress against project indicators, targets, and expected results, and identify trends, underperformance, and areas requiring attention.
· Prepare a comprehensive monthly M&E report presenting analysed data, progress, key findings, challenges, recommendations, and follow-up actions.
· Produce mission-level reports and reports on specific issues as requested by the Base Manager or MEAL Advisor, ensuring that findings are clear, evidence-based, and actionable.
· Generate summaries, graphs, tables, dashboards, and other data visualizations from project databases to support programme reviews, internal reporting, and donor reporting.
· Provide accurate and timely data and analysis for institutional and donor reporting, including reporting requirements from MdM Head Office and donors.
· Ensure that M&E data, reports, and supporting documents are properly recorded, stored, and archived in the appropriate formats and locations.
· Share relevant monitoring findings and analysis with programme teams and management to support timely operational decisions and programme adjustments.
4. Evaluation, Learning and Programme Quality
· Contribute to the design and implementation of baseline, mid-term, end-line, and other evaluations to assess programme relevance, effectiveness, efficiency, results, and impact.
· Identify implementation gaps and lessons learned and provide practical recommendations to improve programme quality and performance.
· Work with project and technical teams to ensure that monitoring and evaluation findings are discussed and incorporated into programme planning, design, and implementation.
· Promote a culture of evidence-based decision-making and learning by facilitating the use of monitoring data and evaluation findings during programme review and planning processes.
5. Accountability to Affected Populations
· Establish, manage, and strengthen an accessible Complaint and Feedback Mechanism (CFM) that enables beneficiaries and communities to raise complaints, provide feedback, and share suggestions safely.
· Ensure that feedback and complaints are documented, referred to the appropriate focal points, followed up, and addressed in a timely and confidential manner, in line with MdM policies and procedures.
· Work closely with field teams and health facility staff to promote awareness of available feedback channels and ensure that beneficiaries know how and where to provide feedback.
· Monitor the quality and accountability of MdM activities and proactively propose tools and templates to assess accountability and beneficiary satisfaction.
· Support capacity building of staff and partners on accountability principles, feedback collection, complaint handling, and safe referral procedures.
6. Capacity Building and Technical Support
· Train and coach Data Clerks, health facility staff, project teams, and partners on M&E principles, data collection tools, data quality, reporting procedures, and basic data analysis.
· Provide ongoing technical support and mentorship to relevant staff to strengthen their capacity in data collection, verification, analysis, and reporting.
· Promote consistent application of MdM M&E tools, indicators, definitions, and reporting procedures across supported facilities and programme locations.

Job Requirements
· University degree (BA) in Statistics, Social Sciences, International Development, Public Health, or another discipline related to MEAL and humanitarian work.
· At least three years of relevant professional experience in a similar M&E/MEAL position, including quantitative and qualitative data collection, survey design, implementation, data management, and analysis.
· Good knowledge of Afghanistan’s public health sector, particularly the Primary Health Care (PHC) system.
· Good understanding of monitoring and evaluation approaches, accountability to affected populations, complaint and feedback mechanisms, and learning practices.
· Familiarity with DHIS2 and routine health information management systems is required or strongly preferred.
· Experience in health facility monitoring, field monitoring visits, data quality assessments, and prescription audits will be an advantage.
· Experience or an academic background in epidemiology, public health, health information management, or a related discipline is an asset.
· Good command of Microsoft Word and Excel and Open Data Kit (ODK) is mandatory. Knowledge of Epi Info and SPSS is an asset.
· Excellent report-writing, data analysis, presentation, and communication skills.
· Ability to identify, collect, clean, verify, and critically analyse information required to perform assigned tasks.
· Professional proficiency in Pashto, Dari, and English, both written and spoken, is mandatory.
· Previous experience working with national or international NGOs is preferred.
· Strong organizational, planning, prioritization, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently and as part of a team.
· Ability to work effectively in a challenging security context and willingness to undertake frequent field visits during working hours.
· Flexibility to adapt the work schedule according to operational requirements.

Submission Guideline
The interested candidates should submit their applications with the updated CV, motivation letter, including references details to the following email – recruitment.afghanistan@medecinsdumonde.net – no later than the closing date.
The reference MEAL Officer must be stated in the application subject to be valid . If you do not clearly state the position for which you are applying & attach the required diploma & other supporting documents, your application may not be considered.
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. Please note that MDM-F does not reimburse transportation cost if applicants are asked for interview or a test.
MDM-F does not charge fee at any stage of its recruitment process . All applications are free for all candidates, and no one should require any payment or compensation during the recruitment process.

title: Resilient and Sustainable Systems for Health (RSSH) Associate [Open to Tier 1 & 2 applicants]
description:
Tiered Approach
In line with the commitment to safeguard capacity and support personnel already in the Organization, a majority of UNDP UNCDF/UNV vacancies are advertised using a tiered application process whereby:
Tier 0 : UNDP/UNCDF/UNV IP staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments, whose posts will be abolished, or contracts will be terminated or not renewed during 2026.
Tier 1 : Other UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments
Tier 2 : UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding temporary appointments (TA), personnel on regular PSA contracts, and Expert and Specialist UN Volunteers
Tier 3 or no tier indicated : All other contract types from UNDP/UNCDF/UNV and other agencies, and other external candidates
Please make note of the Tier(s) indicated in the vacancy title, if any, and ensure that you satisfy the eligibility to apply.
Background
UNDP is the leading United Nations organization fighting to tackle the injustice of poverty, inequality, and climate change on a global scale. Working with our broad network of experts, host governments, and partners in 170 countries, we help nations to build integrated, lasting solutions for people and the planet. UNDP has been working in Afghanistan for more than 50 years on climate change and resilience, gender, governance, health, livelihoods, and the rule of law.
Following the power shift in August 2021, the situation for the country remains largely uncertain and fragile, with approximately seventy percent of the population facing multifaceted vulnerabilities affecting their well-being, human security, and long-term development. While nearly 20 million people are estimated to be acutely food insecure, women and girls are increasingly stripped of their rights to education, employment, and free participation in public life that will have irreversible socioeconomic consequences. Over the recent years, the international humanitarian assistance has played a vital role in averting a socioeconomic collapse by providing lifesaving, resilience-building, and livelihoods-sustaining assistance to millions of people, hundreds of critical healthcare and educational centers, and tens of thousands of small and medium enterprises, often managed by women. Nevertheless, the humanitarian challenge in Afghanistan, which is one of the biggest in the world, and basic human needs and priorities remain extremely high.
To help tackle the pressing challenges of rebuilding livelihoods and climate resilience, UNDP is designing fit-for-purpose portfolios of programs to create new livelihoods, income opportunities, basic services, and to build resilience against climate-induced natural calamities that continue to haunt millions of households in the country.
Afghanistan remains one of the most gender-unequal countries in the world, with women facing systemic challenges hindering their access to education and employment opportunities in the public sector and restricting their participation in public life. UNDP remains committed to women's empowerment through capacity-building initiatives, livelihoods, and self-employment employment support, enhancing gender-responsive decision-making at community level, and supporting local communities to include women, in line with UNSCR 1325 (Women, Peace, and Security).
UNDP adopts a portfolio approach to accommodate changing business needs and leverage linkages across interventions to achieve its strategic goals. This is a recognition of the interconnected nature of development risks and crises that the world is facing and that calls for assembling multidisciplinary teams for an integrated and systemic response. Therefore, UNDP personnel are expected to work across issues, units, functions, teams, and projects in multidisciplinary teams to enhance and enable horizontal collaboration.
As a trusted, long-term partner of The Global Fund to Fight AIDS, Tuberculosis and Malaria (Global Fund, GF), UNDP’s value proposition lies in providing an integrated package of development solutions to strengthen institutions to deliver health services. Through its contributions as interim Principal Recipient and provider of technical assistance in over 53 countries since 2003, UNDP’s provision of integrated policy, implementation and capacity development support to countries has yielded significant health and development results in challenging operating environments. In Afghanistan, UNDP is the interim Principal Recipient (PR) for HIV, tuberculosis, malaria and health systems, with a budget of approximately $59 million for Grant Cycle 8. For effective implementation of the Global Fund resources, UNDP Afghanistan has established a Program Management Unit (PMU), which is responsible for the day-to-day overall programme management, risk management, policy guidance, financial accountability, procurement of goods, including health products and services, strengthening of the national pharmaceutical and laboratory supply chain systems.
Under the direct supervision of the Project Manager, the Resilient and Sustainable Systems for Health (RSSH) Associate will provide administrative, coordination and programme support to the implementation of the Resilient and Sustainable Systems for Health (RSSH) component of the Global Fund grant. The incumbent applies established UNDP rules, policies and procedures and the grant agreement, and works with the PMU team, Sub-recipients (SRs) and national counterparts
Scope of Work
1. Provides administrative and programme support to the implementation of the RSSH component of the Global Fund grant, including the following tasks:
Maintain day-to-day communication with MoPH counterparts and SRs to follow up on scheduled RSSH activities (laboratory systems, HMIS/DHIS2, health products management and supply chain), and relay requests and queries.
Compile inputs for RSSH annual work plans and budgets using established templates and track their status.
Prepare invitations, agendas, minutes and action-point lists for RSSH meetings, task force sessions, workshops and trainings, and arrange the related logistics.
Prepare and process routine requests and supporting documents (e.g., travel, payment, procurement and HR requests) in coordination with the PMU operations teams, in line with UNDP procedures.
Maintain RSSH records, document registers and electronic and hard-copy filing.
2.Supports monitoring and reporting of RSSH activities, including the following tasks:
Update and maintain trackers of RSSH activities, deliverables and indicators, and report delays or discrepancies to the supervisor.
Assist in monitoring visits to RSSH sites and record observations in standard formats.
Compile data and inputs for programme reports (e.g., PUDR, annual and UNDP reports) using established templates, and check SR submissions for completeness against checklists.
Maintain RSSH asset and inventory registers and prepare asset transfer documentation in line with donor and UNDP policy.
Compile documents requested for audits and keep track of the status of audit recommendations.
3.Support partnerships and resource mobilization.
Ensure regular communication and coordination with partners, project counterparts, stakeholders, and beneficiaries; and develop and maintain effective mechanisms for integrating and responding to their feedback and insight.
Support resource mobilization initiatives.
4.Supports knowledge sharing and capacity development in the PMU, including the following tasks:
Compile and file documents, lessons learnt and good practices on RSSH implementation for use by the PMU.

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
Job Description:
B12 's engineering team views software as a craft, but improving the world as the reason to practice it. Our engineers are responsible for prioritizing, conceptualizing, co-designing, building, testing, and engaging users for any concept we are building out. We’re generalists in encouraging each other to experience the full stack, but we’re also aware of each other’s preferences in the stack. For this role in particular, we’re searching for a tenured full-stack engineer who brings strong backend/infrastructure skills (and an interest in using them) to the product. We mentor and teach where we can, both inside and outside of the company, and as a Staff Software Engineer, you will be responsible not only for your ownership of major projects, but also mentorship of the team members with whom you ship those projects.
We value sharing our work with the outside world. Our team has published papers on forming expert flash teams and machine-mediated worker hierarchies. We’ve baked our research into various open source tools in the space of creativity, expertise, and knowledge work.
We hope our engineers have more longevity than any one tool we use, but here is a sampling of our current thoughts about technology:
We live on Python/Django and TypeScript/React.
We store blobs in Amazon’s S3, munch on them in Amazon’s EC2, develop in Docker, and deploy containers to Amazon’s Elastic Beanstalk.
We believe PostgreSQL should be the first system you consider when thinking about persisting structured data.
We clean and centralize data in Amazon’s Redshift, and are able to answer almost any question in SQL.
We leverage AI in our product and our internal tooling, and faced with a landscape in constant flux, try to pick the right model or agent on a task-by-task basis.
Our new code is almost 100% LLM-generated, and we’ve thought hard about ensuring quality in the face of ever-increasing review loads, what processes humans are still best at, and how the practice of mentorship must adapt in the face of these new tools.
We have near-full test coverage on the backend, and are making progress on our frontend and integration tests.
We set up continuous integration and deployment because, while this model comes with its own pains, we’ve disliked being on fixed release schedules on previous projects.
We like to move fast and support point-in-time recovery :).
You’d be a good fit if
You have 10 or more years of experience building products and systems in production.
You are an amazing communicator.
You feel comfortable managing your time and deciding among competing priorities.
You are curious.
You have a high ownership mentality.
You enjoy learning and teaching.
You are comfortable working with backend and frontend technologies, but have a deeper background and interest on the backend/infrastructure side.
You care about and want to contribute to our mission of helping people do meaningful work.
What does a staff engineer do here?
This is B12 ’s first Staff Engineer hire on a ~10-person product team that includes a designer, product manager, and CTO. To understand what we’re looking for in someone with this much experience, here are some concrete examples of tasks you’d work on in a month:
Own the delivery of a project of the magnitude “we ship one or two of these a quarter,” both individually shipping code and rallying and supporting team members in doing so.
Participate in quarterly planning to identify key projects to work on next quarter.
Mentor other engineers who are in the planning, prototyping, or implementation phases of a project.
Respond to an incident, write up a postmortem, and improve tooling and infrastructure to help us prevent or more quickly respond to the issue and others like it in the future.
Identify and optimize some infrastructure that costs too much, is too slow, or isn’t stable enough.

…

description:
Org. Setting and Reporting
This position is located in the United Nations Assistance Mission in Afghanistan (UNAMA) Kabul Main Office. The Information Systems Assistant reports to the Chief of Unit, UNAMA Field Technology Section.
Responsibilities
Within delegated authority and under the direct supervision of Chief FTS, the Information Systems Assistant will perform the following responsibilities: • Plans and directs all major information systems projects within the mission, monitoring the progress of the systems analysis, design, development, testing and implementation of new, moderately complex systems, and/or, participates as a member of a team with responsibility for major components of the more complex systems; • Manages the budget of the Information Systems unit, formulating and monitoring budget allocations and expenditures, verifying funding and ensuring no overrun occurs; • Develops technical specifications for the procurement of equipment and contractual services, and coordinates the technical evaluation of offers and proposals received; • Develops and recommends strategies to implement global information systems projects originating out of DFS/ICTD and the mission; • Develops, implements and monitors information systems standards, guidelines and procedures; • Develops detailed systems and other functional specifications and user documentation for system as required; • Provides specialized advice to users, analysing users’ requirements and translating these into new applications; determines application systems integration and linkage issues; • Maintains, upgrades or enhances existing user systems; troubleshoots and provides continuing support, to include resolving difficult problems, advising on the use of new techniques, monitoring transactions to measure performance and continued effectiveness of assigned systems, etc; • Develops training materials, operating and user manuals; trains staff in assigned systems; • Develops disaster recovery plans relating to information systems and ensures appropriate planning and training of those responsible; • Researches, analyses and evaluates new technologies and makes recommendations for their deployment; • Participates in writing reports and papers on systems-related topics, system requirements, information strategy etc; • Provides professional leadership and work direction for the Unit, develops the yearly work plan, mentors and supervises personnel of the Unit. • Handles all aspects of contract administration including establishment of service level agreements with vendors and chargeback policy for users. • Provides guidance to, and may supervise, new/junior staff, consultants, etc. Internetworking & Infrastructure • Develops plans for major IT systems projects within the mission, monitoring the progress of the design, installation and commissioning of the various systems; • Leads the team in the operation and maintenance of internetworking systems that includes routers and switches, operating systems platforms, database management systems, servers, workstations, and related equipment; • Devises and administers disaster recovery plans; provides training for support staff to implement these plans to ensure optimal readiness; • Responsible for the proper implementation of backup and recovery procedures • Maintains a regular review of the network resources access control, data security including AI threats and unauthorized use of AI and server and data stores security systems, including network segmentation using Cisco ISE and Cisco Firepower Threat Defense (FTD). • Ensures all information security systems are properly configured and maintained, including Check Point and Cisco Firepower firewalls, IPS and malware protection. • Oversees the user access control for network resources and overall network security, including identity-based access with Cisco ISE and 802.1X integrated with Microsoft Entra ID and Entra ID device management, configuration and scripting. • Manages internet traffic across multiple ISP links, including load balancing and traffic rerouting; • Identifies and analyses security incidents using Microsoft Defender and firewall logs; • Provides technical design for CCTV, perimeter intrusion detection and video analytics systems in coordination with UNDSS and UNGSC. • Contributes to the collection and analysis of data as well as identification of trends or pattern and provides draft insight graphs, charts, tables and report using data visualization methods for data-driven planning, decision-making, presentation and reporting. • Documents requirements and background information used for date analysis. • Performs other related duties as required.
Competencies
Professionalism: Shows persistence when faced with difficult problems or challenges. Shows pride in work and in achievements; demonstrates professional competence and mastery of subject matter; is conscientious and efficient in meeting commitments, observing deadlines and achieving results; is motivated by professional rather than personal concerns; shows persistence when faced with difficult problems or challenges; remains calm in stressful situations. Commitment to implementing the goal of gender equality by ensuring the equal participation and full involvement of women and men in all aspects of work. Planning & Organizing: Develops clear goals that are consistent with agreed strategies. Identifies priority activities and assignments; adjusts priorities as required. Allocates appropriate amount of time and resources for completing work. Foresees risks and allows for contingencies when planning. Monitors and adjusts plans and actions as necessary. Uses time efficiently. Technological Awareness: Keeps abreast of available technology. Understands applicability and limitations of technology to the work of the office. Actively seeks to apply technology to appropriate tasks. Shows willingness to learn new technology.
Education
Secondary school, technical school, university and other courses and training programmes relating to the work. High school diploma or equivalent and certification/diploma in other supplemental academic qualifications, training in Information Systems is required. Systems Security Certified Practitioner (SSCP) and GIAC Certified Incident Handler Certifications are required. Other related industry-standard training courses and certifications are desirable.
Job - Specific Qualification
Not available.
Work Experience
Systems Security Certified Practitioner (SSCP) Certification is required. GIAC Certified Incident Handler Certification is required. At least eight (8) years of progressively responsible experience in Information Systems and Technology, or related area, including enterprise network, wireless and ICT security operations. Experience in Information Systems and Technology within the United Nations system in support of peacekeeping operations is required. Experience in carrying out programmatic/administrative tasks necessary for the functioning of the Unit including preparation of cost estimates/budgets, reporting on budget/programme performance, contracting vendor services is required. title: Director of Technology Operations
description:
Coinspaid Dev is the engineering brand behind the technology, infrastructure, and R&D expertise built within Coinspaid. With more than 120 engineersand over 11 years of industry experience, Coinspaid Dev brings together software engineering, infrastructure, security and R&D teams with experience building distributed systems and blockchain infrastructure operating across more than 20 blockchain networks.
Coinspaid Dev emerges as an independent engineering brand with a straightforward mission: to advance blockchain infrastructure engineering and contribute practical expertise back to the industry. The structure is new. The experience behind it is not.
Director of Technology Operations
We are building the next operating model for a ~150-person technology organization behind production-critical financial infrastructure.
We are looking for a Director of Technology Operations to lead that transformation.
This is not a traditional infrastructure or IT operations role. The mandate is to evolve Technology Operations from a primarily reactive model toward a scalable organization built around clear ownership, platform engineering, automation, self-service, operational excellence, resilience and measurable outcomes .
You will initially lead several established technology functions through their existing Heads and Leads, with approximately 25 people across Platform/DevOps, Corporate IT and Operational Excellence . The mandate is broader than the initial team size: you will help shape the operating model of a ~150-person technology organization and build capabilities designed to scale significantly beyond today's structure.
Your responsibility will go beyond managing these teams. You will help shape how the broader technology organization operates: how production services are owned, how incidents and changes are managed, how engineers consume infrastructure capabilities, how operational risks are identified, and how recurring manual work is systematically eliminated.
A major part of the role is organizational transformation. We expect you to assess the current model, challenge it where necessary, define the target state, develop the leaders underneath you, and deliver measurable improvements rather than simply introduce new processes.
The goal is straightforward: as the company grows, Technology Operations should become more reliable, resilient and scalable while requiring less manual coordination, less operational toil and less executive intervention .
What you will do
Lead the transformation of Technology Operations across Platform/DevOps, Corporate IT and Operational Excellence, moving the organization from reactive operations toward ownership, automation, self-service and measurable outcomes.
Define the Technology Operations strategy, target operating model, organizational structure, responsibilities, priorities and transformation roadmap.
Lead multiple established technology functions through Heads, Leads and other managers, creating clear accountability and developing leaders who can operate with increasing autonomy.
Lead the evolution of DevOps toward a Platform Engineering model that reduces operational toil, increases self-service and improves developer productivity while maintaining reliability and security.
Partner with Engineering to establish a "you build it, you own it" model , where product teams retain ownership of their services in production while Technology Operations provides the platform, standards, tooling and operational framework that enable them to operate reliably.
Develop Service Management toward Operational Excellence: strengthen service ownership, incident and problem management, introduce risk-based change governance, reduce unnecessary manual controls, and use operational data to eliminate systemic causes of failures.
Transform Corporate IT toward a secure, automated employee technology model , with strong identity and access lifecycle management, device management, governance and employee self-service.

title: Product Engineer (PM)
description:
Location: Fully Remote
Compensation: $23.08 to $34.62 USD/hour
Benefits: 15 days PTO. Christmas Day and New Year's Day paid off.
Fair warning: the pace is intense and the ambiguity is real. But you'll feel yourself growing every single week, even the rough ones, and you'll be doing it next to people who actually celebrate your wins and have your back.
We're the all-in-one agentic marketing platform. AI-native from day one. We're not joining a category, we're defining it.
We're looking for a Product Engineer to own a pod's output end-to-end: strategy, specs, QA, and enough technical depth to unblock engineers or write the code yourself when that's the fastest path forward. If you want real ownership, move fast, and raise the bar every week, keep reading. If you've been waiting for a PM role that doesn't ask you to leave your technical background at the door, this is it.
What you'll own
Own the roadmap for your pod: define what gets built, kill low-leverage work, and protect your engineers' time and focus
Write specs that start with the problem, not the solution, and ship every brief with a clear success criterion
Participate technically: read the codebase, debug independently, and ship small things when it's faster than context-switching an engineer
Own QA end-to-end: test plans, regression passes, release sign-off, and post-deploy monitoring in Sentry and Grafana
Keep the pod moving: fast decisions, async-first communication, and zero ambiguity about what's next
Close the feedback loop between customers, data, and product direction, and hold yourself accountable to the KPIs you define
You'll thrive here if...
You've shipped production code before and you're honest with yourself about your technical depth
You treat a spec as a hypothesis to pressure-test, not a document to execute against
You don't wait to be told what to do. You see the gap and you move.
Deadlines don't rattle you. Ambiguity doesn't either.
You're an AI power user, not someone who's "open to learning it someday."
You communicate clearly, especially when things are unclear.
You have opinions and you're not afraid to bring them.
You can laugh at a chaotic week on Friday and mean it.
What we're looking for
3+ years of product management experience in B2B SaaS, startup or high-growth environment
A hands-on technical background: production code, a bootcamp, or demonstrable ability to navigate a full-stack codebase
Comfortable reading Python and JavaScript/TypeScript; able to write SQL, reason about REST contracts, and follow frontend state
Proven QA ownership: test cases, regression cycles, structured bug reports, release sign-off
Daily fluency with Claude Code or equivalent. Not "open to it." Actually using it.
Strong written communication. Your specs are clear and complete on the first read.
Available in EST
What working here actually looks like
High expectations. Real ownership. Things change fast and we don't apologize for it. You'll work with smart people who push you, a product that keeps getting better, and a team that's genuinely building something new.
The boundary between product and engineering is intentionally blurred here. The best product decisions are inseparable from technical reality, and we hire people who understand that.
We'll probably give you more to own than you expected. That's on purpose.
We use AI every day, across every function. That's just how we work.
What we stand for
We are obsessed with our customers, and making them obsessed with us
We figure it the f**k out
We go to war on our problems quickly
We are strategic. We work smart, not just hard.
We're fun AF
About Search Atlas
Search Atlas helps marketing teams move faster, make smarter decisions, and do more with less. We're a $30M+ ARR company, 215 people, bootstrapped, and building the infrastructure for the next era of marketing. No outside funding. No fluff. Just product.

title: Pashto Language Specialist - AI Trainer
description:
Are you a Pashto language specialist eager to shape the future of AI? Large-scale language models are evolving from clever chatbots into powerful tools for communication, education, and cultural understanding. With high-quality training data, tomorrow’s AI can accurately capture Pashto vocabulary, grammar, idiomatic expressions, and cultural context—helping preserve linguistic heritage and support authentic interactions. That training data begins with you—we need your expertise to help power the next generation of AI.
We’re looking for Pashto language specialists who live and breathe phonetics, morphology, syntax, dialectical variations, colloquial expressions, and cultural references. You’ll challenge advanced language models on topics like contextual interpretation, semantic accuracy, and cultural nuance—documenting every failure mode so we can harden model reasoning.
On a typical day, you will converse with the model in Pashto across a wide range of topics, verify linguistic accuracy and cultural relevance, capture reproducible error traces, and suggest improvements to our prompt engineering and evaluation metrics.
A degree in Linguistics, Pashto Studies, Translation, or a related field is ideal; professional experience in teaching, translation, language documentation, or community work signals fit. Clear, metacognitive communication—“showing your work”—is essential.
Ready to turn your Pashto expertise into the knowledge base for tomorrow’s AI? Apply today and start teaching the model that will teach the world.
We offer a pay range of $8-to-$65 per hour, with the exact rate determined after evaluating your experience, expertise, and geographic location. Final offer amounts may vary from the pay range listed above. As a contractor you’ll supply a secure computer and high-speed internet; company-sponsored benefits such as health insurance and PTO do not apply.

title: Persian Trilingual Language Specialist – AI Trainer
description:
Are you fluent in Persian, English, and at least one additional language, and eager to apply your linguistic expertise to the future of AI? Large-scale language models are transforming how people communicate, learn, and access information across cultures. With high-quality multilingual training data, tomorrow’s AI can better serve global communities with accuracy, nuance, and inclusivity. That training data begins with you.
We’re looking for a Persian Trilingual Language Specialist who can bring deep linguistic knowledge, cultural awareness, and multilingual proficiency to AI training. You’ll work with cutting-edge AI tools to evaluate, annotate, and refine model outputs in Persian, English, and your third language, helping improve cross-lingual reasoning, translation quality, and naturalness.
On a typical day, you will review AI-generated text for grammatical accuracy, idiomatic expression, and cultural appropriateness; annotate and correct linguistic errors; assess multilingual translations for clarity and fidelity; and collaborate with our team to strengthen evaluation protocols and language-specific guidelines.
Fluency in Persian and English, plus proficiency in at least one additional language, is required. Prior experience in translation, linguistics, content evaluation, or AI training is strongly preferred. Clear communication skills, attention to detail, and the ability to articulate linguistic nuances across languages are essential.
Ready to apply your multilingual expertise to shape the AI of tomorrow? Apply today and help build tools that will empower communication for people worldwide.
We offer a pay range of $6 to $65 per hour, with the exact rate determined after evaluating your experience, expertise, and geographic location. Final offer amounts may vary from the pay range listed above. As a contractor you’ll supply a secure computer and reliable internet connection; company-sponsored benefits such as health insurance and PTO do not apply.

title: IT Manager / Managed IT Services (Open to Individuals & Companies)
salary: As per the Organization's salary scale
description:
Job Summary
Position Summary: Ariana Medical Complex invites qualified individual IT professionals and eligible IT companies or service providers to apply for the management and support of the hospital’s information technology systems.
The selected individual or service provider will be responsible for planning, managing, maintaining, securing, and improving the hospital’s IT infrastructure and services. These services must support the hospital’s clinical, administrative, financial, and operational activities while ensuring system reliability, information security, confidentiality of patient data, and continuity of essential hospital services.
Applicants may apply under one of the following categories:
Category A – Individual IT Manager: An experienced IT professional responsible for managing the hospital’s IT operations and supervising the hospital’s IT staff.
Category B – IT Company / Service Provider: A qualified company that provides IT management services through a designated IT manager and an appropriately skilled technical team under an agreement with the hospital.
Key Responsibilities:
A. Strategic Leadership and IT Governance
Develop and implement an IT strategy aligned with the hospital’s objectives and healthcare service requirements.
Establish, review, and maintain IT policies, procedures, technical standards, and operational controls.
Advise hospital management on technology investments, digital transformation, system improvements, and IT-related risks.
Develop an annual IT work plan, including priorities, resource requirements, maintenance schedules, and improvement activities.
Ensure IT operations support the hospital’s clinical, administrative, financial, and operational departments.
B. IT Operations and Infrastructure
Manage and maintain servers, computer networks, databases, applications, workstations, printers, scanners, switches, cameras, and related equipment.
Ensure the availability, performance, reliability, and proper functioning of critical hospital IT systems.
Manage network architecture, routing, connectivity, wireless networks, internet services, email systems, and internal communications.
Coordinate installation, configuration, preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of IT equipment.
Maintain an updated inventory of IT equipment, software, licenses, systems, and related assets.
Minimize service interruptions and coordinate timely resolution of technical problems.
C. Information Security and Data Protection
Protect the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of hospital information and patient records.
Implement appropriate access controls, user account management, password policies, endpoint protection, and security monitoring.
Establish and maintain regular data backup, restoration testing, disaster recovery, and business continuity procedures.
Monitor and address cybersecurity risks, vulnerabilities, unauthorized access, malware, and other security incidents.
Ensure that access to patient information is restricted to authorized personnel and permitted purposes.
Report significant security incidents promptly to the designated hospital authority.
Ensure that hospital data is not copied, transferred, disclosed, or used without proper authorization.
D. Systems Development and Improvement
Assess, recommend, install, configure, and maintain suitable hardware, software, and technology solutions.
Support the effective operation and improvement of hospital information systems, including clinical, administrative, financial, and other approved platforms.
Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend cost-effective solutions that improve hospital services.
Coordinate system upgrades, software updates, equipment replacement, and technical projects.
Ensure that changes to critical systems are properly authorized, documented, tested, and implemented.
E. IT Support and Team Management
Provide or coordinate timely technical support to all hospital departments.
Supervise, guide, and evaluate hospital IT staff, where applicable.
Ensure proper allocation of IT duties, technical coverage, staff development, and performance monitoring.
Establish a system for receiving, recording, prioritizing, tracking, and resolving IT support requests.
Provide advanced technical assistance for complex IT and system-related issues.
Maintain appropriate technical coverage for critical hospital services, including agreed arrangements for urgent and after-hours support.
F. Budget, Procurement, and Vendor Management
Prepare or contribute to the annual IT budget, equipment replacement plan, and maintenance requirements.
Recommend cost-effective procurement of IT equipment, software, licenses, and technical services.
Coordinate with authorized hospital departments regarding procurement specifications, vendor evaluation, and technical acceptance.
Manage technical relationships with internet providers, software vendors, equipment suppliers, and other service providers.
Monitor vendor performance, warranties, service agreements, licenses, and maintenance commitments.
Ensure that procurement and expenditure recommendations are submitted through the hospital’s approved authorization procedures.
G. Compliance, Documentation, and Reporting
Ensure compliance with hospital policies, applicable regulations, accreditation requirements, and approved information security procedures.
Maintain updated technical documentation, network diagrams, system configurations, equipment inventories, access records, and maintenance logs.
Prepare regular reports covering system availability, support requests, incidents, cybersecurity risks, completed activities, and proposed improvements.
Report major risks, service disruptions, resource gaps, and unresolved technical issues to the designated hospital authority.
Perform other relevant duties assigned by hospital leadership within the approved scope of work.
2. Confidentiality and Ownership of Hospital Information
The selected individual or company must:
Sign the required confidentiality and data protection undertaking before receiving access to hospital systems or information.
Use hospital data and systems solely for authorized purposes.
Maintain appropriate safeguards for patient information, employee records, financial information, and other confidential hospital data.
Refrain from retaining, disclosing, transferring, or using hospital information after termination of the engagement, except where expressly authorized or legally required.
Ensure that all hospital data, configurations, documentation, credentials, and other hospital-owned information remain under the hospital’s control.
Return hospital property and transfer all required records, documentation, credentials, and system access arrangements upon termination or completion of the assignment.
3. Deliverables and Performance Indicators
The selected individual or company will be expected to provide the following deliverables according to an agreed implementation schedule:
No.
Deliverable
Performance Indicator
1
Initial IT assessment and improvement plan
Assessment and prioritized action plan submitted and approved
2
IT asset and system inventory
Inventory maintained and updated
3
IT maintenance plan
Preventive maintenance conducted and documented
4
IT support and incident management
Requests recorded, tracked, and handled within agreed service levels
5
Data backup and recovery plan
Backups monitored and restoration tests documented
6
Information security measures
Access controls reviewed and security incidents reported
7
IT documentation
Essential technical documentation maintained and updated
8
Periodic performance reports
Reports submitted according to the agreed reporting schedule
9
Annual IT plan and budget recommendations
Submitted within the timeline approved by hospital management
10
Handover and continuity arrangements
Complete handover completed at the end of the engagement
Specific uptime targets, response times, resolution targets, and other service-level indicators shall be agreed upon in the contract or service agreement, taking into account the hospital’s operational requirements and available resources.

Job Requirements
4. Additional Requirements for Individual Applicants
Individual applicants must meet the following minimum requirements:
Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field. A master’s degree is an advantage.
At least five years of progressively responsible IT experience, including at least two years in a supervisory or managerial role.
Experience in server administration, network management, cybersecurity, backup systems, disaster recovery, and IT support.
Experience managing enterprise-level infrastructure; experience in a hospital or other healthcare institution is an advantage.
Strong leadership, planning, troubleshooting, communication, and decision-making skills.
High professional integrity and commitment to confidentiality and data protection.
Fluency in Dari, Pashto, and English, with the ability to communicate effectively in the languages required for the assignment.
Ability to provide the services and meet the attendance, availability, and reporting requirements agreed with the hospital.
5. Additional Requirements for IT Companies / Service Providers
Companies applying for this assignment must provide evidence of their ability to deliver reliable IT management services in a hospital environment.
Minimum requirements include:
Valid business registration and authorization to provide IT-related services under applicable Afghan laws and regulations.
Demonstrated experience in IT infrastructure management, technical support, networking, cybersecurity, systems maintenance, or related services.
A company profile describing its technical capabilities, service coverage, organizational structure, and relevant experience.
Evidence of previous relevant assignments, including client references or completion certificates where available.
A proposed service delivery team, including a designated IT Manager or Team Leader and appropriately qualified technical personnel.
CVs, educational qualifications, and relevant experience records for key personnel assigned to the hospital.
A technical proposal explaining the proposed management approach, service delivery arrangements, support coverage, escalation procedures, backup strategy, cybersecurity measures, and reporting arrangements.
A proposed service-level arrangement specifying response times, resolution targets, system monitoring, preventive maintenance, and emergency support.
A financial proposal detailing professional fees, staffing costs, maintenance charges, and any additional costs, clearly identifying applicable exclusions.
Written acceptance of the hospital’s confidentiality, patient data protection, access control, and information security requirements.
The company shall nominate a qualified person to serve as its primary contact and IT Manager for the assignment. Replacement of key personnel must be subject to prior approval by the hospital.
6. Evaluation and Selection Criteria
Applications will be evaluated according to the applicant category.
For individual applicants:
Educational qualifications and relevant certifications.
Years and relevance of IT management experience.
Technical competence and problem-solving ability.
Leadership and communication skills.
Healthcare or comparable enterprise IT experience.
Proposed approach to managing the hospital’s IT operations.
For companies / service providers:
Legal registration and eligibility.
Relevant company experience and past performance.
Qualifications and experience of the proposed IT Manager and technical team.
Technical proposal and service delivery methodology.
Availability, support coverage, cybersecurity, and continuity arrangements.
Financial proposal and overall value for money.
Ariana Medical Complex reserves the right to verify submitted documents, contact references, conduct interviews or technical assessments, request clarification, and select the applicant that best meets the hospital’s requirements, subject to its approved procedures.
7. Contractual and Administrative Arrangements
Individual applicants, if selected, shall enter into an employment or individual service contract, as determined by the hospital.
Companies, if selected, shall enter into a service agreement defining the scope of services, deliverables, staffing arrangements, service levels, payment terms, confidentiality obligations, performance monitoring, and termination conditions.
The final scope, contract duration, payment structure, working arrangements, and reporting requirements shall be agreed upon and approved by the hospital before commencement.
No applicant may access hospital systems or patient information before the required authorization and confidentiality arrangements are in place.
The hospital retains authority over strategic decisions, procurement approvals, system access authorization, and other reserved management functions.

Submission Guideline
8. Application Procedure
Interested individuals and eligible companies may submit their applications quoting the Job tile and the Vacancy Announcement Number (AMC | HRD-897) in the subject line to email.
Individual applicants should submit:
Updated CV.
Application letter.
Copies of educational certificates and relevant professional certifications.
Evidence of relevant work experience.
A brief technical approach to managing hospital IT services.
Fluency in English, Dari, and Pashto (spoken and written).
Companies / service providers should submit:
Company profile and valid registration documents.
Technical proposal and service delivery methodology.
Relevant contracts, references, or evidence of previous assignments.

Proposed service-level arrangements and support coverage.
Detailed financial proposal.
Applications that do not include the required documents by November 30, 2026 or fail to mention the Vacancy Announcement Number and Job Title in the subject line will not be considered.

title: DevOps Engineer (Vac DST)
description:
About Logos (λ)
Logos (λ) is a movement of technologists, creatives, strategists, and activists working together to build a sovereign, people-owned technology stack that revitalises civil society and protects digital liberties at scale.
This position is within the IFT Technical Services (IFT-TS) Distributed Systems Testing (DST) Team, a team that primarily supports Logos, while also contributing to other IFT projects.
The role
We are seeking an experienced Distributed Systems Evaluation Engineer to join the Institute of Free Technology - Technical Services, on the Distributed Systems Testing (IFT-TS DST) team. This role focuses on rigorously assessing the performance and reliability of IFT projects at scale, where Logos (λ) is one of them.
Logos (λ) technology stack is composed of 3 main components:
Logos (λ) Blockchain : Advanced privacy for a new era of decentralised applications and social institutions.
Logos (λ) Messaging : Private peer‑to‑peer communication that resists surveillance and censorship.
Logos (λ) Storage : Secure decentralised storage enabling fully decentralised apps and file sharing.
We are looking for a talented and enthusiastic DevOps Engineer to join our Distributed Systems Testing (DST) team.
You’ll be responsible for designing and executing comprehensive evaluation strategies, leveraging both large-scale lab deployments and protocol behavior modeling scripts. Your expertise will be crucial in analyzing these complex distributed systems, automating intricate test scenarios, and providing in-depth insights into system behaviors.
Working closely with cross-functional teams, you’ll troubleshoot complex issues and translate technical data into actionable recommendations. Proficiency in containerization, cloud technologies, and distributed systems principles is essential.
Key responsibilities
Design, configure, and optimize Kubernetes clusters to support large-scale experiments and benchmarks of P2P technologies.
Continuously improve cluster scalability and resource utilization, enabling increasingly complex deployments and experiments.
Set up, maintain, and optimize supporting infrastructure such as monitoring, logging, and observability stacks (Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, etc.).
Collaborate with DST researchers and engineers to streamline experimentation workflows and make analysis easier and more reproducible.
Automate infrastructure and deployment workflows to increase reliability and reduce overhead.
Troubleshoot, profile, and tune distributed workloads to ensure accurate and performant benchmarking.
Identify, reproduce, and debug complex issues in distributed systems, working closely with Logos development teams.
You ideally will have
Strong experience with Kubernetes and container orchestration in production or research environments.
Solid understanding of cloud infrastructure, Linux systems, and networking (especially relevant to distributed/P2P systems).
Familiarity with monitoring and logging tools (Grafana, Prometheus, VictoriaLogs, etc.).
Experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform, Ansible, Helm, etc.).
Proficiency in at least one scripting/programming language (ideally Python).
Interest in or experience with distributed systems, P2P networks, or blockchain technologies.
Experience with networks and systems programming.
Excellent written and conversational communication skills.
Alignment with our core values and principles.
Bonus points
Hands-on experience with libp2p or projects in the Logos collective.
Background in performance benchmarking, scalability testing, or systems research.
Contributions to open source projects.
Experience working for an open-source organization.
Interview Process
Interview with our POps team
Interview with team member from the IFT-TS DST team
Take-home assignment and discussion of results
Interview with IFT-TS team lead

description:

You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models.

Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume.
Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate.

Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it.
Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round.

Experience building agent tasks or RL environments

title: Senior Platform Security Engineer
description:

Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.
More broadly, Discord is about empowering people to find belonging in all kinds of communities, and those people trust us to keep their communications safe. Our Platform Security Engineering team protects the systems we use to create Discord, making the "secure way" the "easy way."
We're looking for a Senior Engineer to advance this mission through security expertise, software development, and operational excellence, with a particular focus on identity and access management: who and what can access Discord's systems, how they authenticate, and how access stays scoped to what's actually needed. You'll help identify leveraged opportunities to reduce security risk across Engineering, then design and deliver technical solutions: lovable "paved paths" for managing identities and access, shipping code, configuring cloud infrastructure, and operating services.
If you're a security engineer with a deep interest in identity and access management, who's eager to own technically and socially complex projects, and excited to improve security and privacy at Discord, read on!
This position can be based in California, Washington, or Oregon. For those within 50 miles of our San Francisco office, the Hiring Manager would like folks to be in the office 1-2 days a week.
What you'll do
Own software engineering projects end-to-end on a highly autonomous, horizontally integrated team with a lot of leverage. This is a code-forward role!
Define what identity means for autonomous agents and other non-human actors at Discord (how they're provisioned, scoped, authenticated, authorized, and audited). As the role of these actors grows, and create primitives to implement that vision.
Build and evolve Access , Discord's employee authorization platform, to make permissions discoverable, role-based, least privilege, and self-serve; check out our blog post to learn more!
Design and harden our Zero Trust architecture, spanning human and service-to-service auth*n for Discord’s internal tooling.
Automate continuous permission right-sizing in the spirit of least privilege.
Develop and apply secure baselines for cloud identity, and help secure our software supply chain from the dev environment through CI/CD and into production.
Consult on risk assessments, architectural designs, threat models, code reviews, and more, pragmatically balancing security with other business considerations.
Example projects
Integrate service-to-service and agent-to-service authentication and authorization as out-of-the-box features in Discord's internal developer platform.
Build out service identity provisioning using PKI and mTLS, so services can authenticate each other without shared secrets.
Evaluate or extend infrastructure access tooling such as Teleport for short-lived, auditable access to hosts, databases, and internal systems.
Improve how secrets are issued, rotated, and scoped across our infrastructure.
What we look for
5+ years of experience building and operating production systems or infrastructure
3+ years of experience writing software in a general-purpose programming language (we mainly use Python, TypeScript, and Rust)
3+ years of experience securing systems with millions of users
Experience building or operating identity and access management systems: authentication, authorization, or access control at scale
Understanding of modern authentication and authorization concepts (e.g. RBAC, OAuth, OIDC, SSO, Zero Trust network architectures, mTLS, cloud IAM)
Experience building in and securing multi-cloud environments (e.g. GCP, Cloudflare, AWS)

Discord's Enterprise Technology org is building a software engineering discipline from the ground up, and this is the founding engineering hire. There is no Enterprise Platform team yet. You will not be maintaining a status quo or joining an existing backlog: you will define the discipline, set the technical foundation, and build the platform that lets the internal systems enabling Discordians scale with the company.
Discord's mission is to cultivate belonging, and doing that at scale requires internal systems that move as fast as the product itself. The mission of this role is to turn our enterprise infrastructure into self-service software. Your job is to replace manual consoles and tickets with a platform of reusable primitives, building blocks like "provision a device" or "push an IAM policy or app integration through code," exposed through clean APIs and self-service portals. As a code-forward Staff engineer, you will design abstractions that hide the messy reality of Okta, Jamf, and Terraform (our identity, device management, and infrastructure-as-code tools) behind interfaces people actually want to use, operating with a platform-as-a-product mindset.
What You'll Do
Manage the device fleet as code: Move device configuration off consoles and into versioned, API-driven infrastructure for endpoint management and hardware provisioning.
Automate the identity layer: Manage identity systems and their connections to downstream apps as code, from SSO and SCIM integrations to account workflows, so changes ship through version control and CI/CD instead of an admin console.
Own app delivery and Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC): Build deployment pipelines and provisioning patterns that let internal systems be built and changed safely, establishing CI/CD standards.
Build the self-service layer: Design and ship the APIs, CLIs, and portals that compose primitives into paved paths, like a new hire's first day, where software access and group memberships land in one automated, auditable flow.
Set the foundation: Define the technical direction and architecture for the discipline, writing the RFCs and documentation that future hires will build on.
What You Should Have
6+ years building and operating production software and systems at a technology company, with a track record of owning ambiguous projects end to end.
Strong software engineering fundamentals. You write production code (we lean on Python, TypeScript and Rust), and design, test, and ship it. This is not a systems admin role.
Deep, hands-on IAM experience (SSO, SCIM, OAuth/OIDC, RBAC) and fluency with infrastructure as code (Terraform) and CI/CD.
Experience treating endpoint and fleet management as an API-driven engineering surface at scale.
A platform-as-a-product mindset. You have built self-service tooling that people chose to adopt.
Comfort with ambiguity and a founder's temperament; energized by building from scratch.
Bonus Points
Hands-on experience with Okta, Jamf, or Intune.
Experience with identity and access governance for non-human, workload, or AI-agent principals.
Background at a high-growth consumer tech company with a highly technical employee base.

We’re hiring seasoned engineers to join our teams that work on the financial backbone of Gusto's money movement — the ledger, reconciliation, and reporting systems that account for every dollar, and the payment profile that determines how employers fund payroll and how employees and contractors get paid. title: AI Research Engineer
description:
About Syd Life AI
We build life quality infrastructure that compounds validated research and action into better living .
Syd , our companion , draws on 2.7 million+ peer-reviewed studies and 14.3 billion+ person-years of longitudinal data , and turns that evidence into action across nine dimensions of life quality . Every recommendation traces back to its evidence . Syd is available in 30 languages and deployed in 26 countries .
Privacy and security sit at the centre of how we build : SOC 2 , ISO 27001 , ISO 42001 , GDPR and HIPAA .
Our goal is to give people their agency back . We hire people who already act that way : you choose the problem , test the idea against the evidence and measure the impact . Small remote team , real ownership from your first week , consulting agreements with equity .
The role
Syd is looking for an AI Research Engineer to join the AI & Research team and work directly with the team lead on open problems across the full range of Syd's work , from the intelligence members interact with to the models , data and research systems behind it . AI tools write most of the code in our team , and you will use them every day . Your contribution is the question you ask , the experiment you design , the measurement you trust and the decision you can defend . Autonomy is high : you choose problems and propose ideas , with direction and review from the team lead .
What you bring
A PhD in a quantitative or life science field , such as neuroscience , mathematics , physics , biomedical engineering , statistics or computational biology , or an equivalent record of original research that is active and recent .
First-hand work with real , imperfect data , and confidence with study design , effect sizes , uncertainty , baselines and calibration .
A first-principles understanding of how large language models are trained and adapted ( pre-training , SFT , LoRA , distillation , PPO and GRPO ) , with hands-on practice in at least one .
Evidence discipline : you state what result would prove you wrong before you run the experiment , and report negative results as readily as positive ones .
Daily use of coding agents and frontier models , with a clear way of checking their output .
Clear , concise written English and comfort working autonomously in a remote team .
What you will do
Design new behaviours , memory and tools for language model agents that support members across every dimension of their life quality .
Design evaluations before a feature is built , with automated judges validated against human review .
Build methods that turn the scientific literature into structured , source-checked evidence .
Train predictive models on large real-world datasets , with attention to calibration , bias and validity across populations .
Fine-tune and evaluate open and closed models where a specialised model serves people well .
Terms
Remote , open to candidates anywhere in the world . Consulting agreement with equity .
How to apply
Apply at careers.syd.life/careers/ai-research-engineer , with a research sample and a one-page note as described on the page . Every candidate completes an online assessment and a 48-hour task before any interview .

description:
Headquarters: Remote US
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.
The Fraud team at Affirm Bank works cross-functionally with Machine Learning, Product, Engineering, Operations to combat fraudulent activities to foster a safe platform.

This individual will be the representative of the Credit Risk org, leading the charge on refining our Identity Verification and Fraud processes as well as our Application flow. What You'll Do
This role will take charge of owning fraud performance for depository products, including monitoring fraud losses, approval rates, false positives, customer friction, and other key risk metrics
Data Pipeline, Analytics & Monitoring
Build and maintain scalable data models and transformation pipelines, using tools (such as DBT) to standardize depository product, transaction, customer, fraud, and operational data.
Define trusted fraud performance metrics and analytical datasets, including fraud loss rates, approval and decline rates, false-positive rates, customer friction, and operational efficiency.

Evaluate new data sources and signals to improve detection of identity risk, account takeover, device risk, transaction risk, and other fraud typologies relevant to depository products.
Lead testing and performance measurement of fraud strategy changes, including rule launches, model updates, policy changes, and new product controls, with clear pre- and post-implementation evaluation.
Partner cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Machine Learning, Data Engineering, Fraud Operations, and Risk to improve fraud strategies, strengthen operational feedback loops, and support new product launches.

EXPERIENCE - 7+ years’ of Analytics experience
PRODUCT KNOWLEDGE - Passion to understand how Affirm product works and a curious mindset to help change and make it more effective
TECHNICAL SKILLS - Fluent in SQL and Python

RISK KNOWLEDGE - Working knowledge of the fundamentals of payment processing and an understanding of industry risk trends, including familiarity with fraud strategy development
We also encourage you to read our Chief Risk Officer’s views on what makes Credit Risk Managers influential and on a Modern Risk Management System .
Base Pay Grade - M
Equity Grade - USA 8
Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range . Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.

Strong investigative judgement and the ability to produce clear, structured long-form reports tailored to technical, compliance, leadership, and cross-functional audiences.

The On-Prem team ships CircleCI Server, our self-hosted CI/CD platform for customers who need to run everything inside their own infrastructure: regulated industries, air-gapped environments, and teams with strict data residency and compliance requirements. Our mission is to deliver an on-premises CircleCI that is secure, highly available, and easy to install, upgrade, and support.

Build AI-natively. AI is how we work. It's not a productivity layer on top of engineering, but the default starting point for how we approach and solve problems.

Build diagnostics that help operators, and the engineers supporting them, find the problem quickly. description:
